body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, do you know
the story of the DCCC blacklist?

In 2018, AOC defeated the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House.
Corporate Democrats were reeling.

The DCCC went to extreme lengths to stop progressives like AOC from ever
winning again. The DCCC blacklisted any vendors, staffers, and
organizations that supported primary challengers to Democratic incumbents,
to weaken our movement.

The DCCC wanted to block working-class progressives like AOC from critical
campaign resources. Of course, they had no issue using corporate firms
that bust unions, work with Big Oil, and even lobby for the GOP’s
right-wing agenda.

It’s not right,
Peter. The DCCC ended the
blacklist after it became a PR nightmare, but they laid the groundwork for
groups like AIPAC and the Moderate PAC that want to take down our
candidates. Now, AIPAC is openly recruiting against our progressive
incumbents and the establishment has been absolutely silent on the matter.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137161?refcode=em20230821-30479&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30479%2E1203867%2EaEHN63 ]In order to change the Democratic Party, we have to weather their
ongoing attacks and protect the Squad. Can you chip in $3
so we can fight the status quo, overcome the odds, and expand the Squad?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137161?refcode=em20230821-30479&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30479%2E1203867%2EaEHN63 ]Contribute $3

We’re not like the DCCC.

1. We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs. Our candidates' and our own
work are 100% grassroots-funded.
2. We don’t work with “Democratic” firms associated with union busting,
corporate America, or the GOP.
3. Our strategy pays off — we have elected Justice Democrats and grown
the Squad every cycle, while the last Chair of the DCCC lost the seat
to a Republican.

Corporate Democrats take money from Wall Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma,
payday loan companies, and union-busters. It’s clear: Justice Democrats
will fight for the people, the Democratic establishment will work for
their corporate donors.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137161?refcode=em20230821-30479&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=30479%2E1203867%2EaEHN63 ]Peter,
we’re determined to keep winning against
the Democratic establishment and its Wall Street-backed candidates. Will
you chip in to help power our work so we can elect more Justice Democrats?

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1022&akid=30479%2E1203867%2EaEHN63 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

**About Jim Jordan:** Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**
In Washington, Jim Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility,and he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

The rapidly escalating US China War is disrupting many economic, military, and geopolitical relationships. The cross currents of the conflict are creating a complicated cocktail in which the economic interests of nations are increasingly taking a back seat to military and political considerations. Nowhere in the world is this development more obvious than in Australia.
Canberra is one of Washington's closest allies and has been a steadfast partner on military and geopolitical matters. In fact, "[Australian and American soldiers, sailors, marines, airmen and women have served alongside one another in every major conflict](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/238121a0-a53e-4d51-88b0-09c4bcb663bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" since World War I, something that is often noted by leaders in both Washington and Canberra. Australia is also a member of the Five Eyes, an intelligence sharing pact formed following World War II that includes the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c7c42439-1443-48ac-9d41-3b2176d4290e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Joint Defense Facility Pine Gap; picture by [Kristian Laemmle-Ruff](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5178c52f-611e-47bf-9fac-656ba5c87a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In addition, a mere 11 miles from Alice Springs in the Northern Territories (close to the geographic center of the Australian continent) lies Pine Gap, a joint Australian-America surveillance base created more than 50 years ago that [collects signals intelligence, provides early warning information on ballistic missile launches, gathers and disseminates battlefield intelligence](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/58d16f1e-a3cd-4ce1-bd2a-3bca7a9f54fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and served as the inspiration for the eponymous[ international political thriller on Netflix](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1eadc91c-8610-460f-9f44-138c74628bd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z-rYEVFsEzVJpEByLkAyVNopmJXmFq2W7hyrLo76SOw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136279018)
And in 2021, Canberra, London, and Washington formed AUKUS (Australia-United Kingdom-United States), a defense collaboration with two main efforts: "[The first initiative under AUKUS is a commitment to support Australia in acquiring nuclear-powered submarines for the Royal Australian Navy. The second initiative intends to enhance joint capabilities and interoperability, focusing on cyber capabilities, artificial intelligence, quantum technologies and additional undersea capabilities](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3d1d19d4-72ee-4ef3-9df8-364d15305ccf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Given the sensitive technologies involved, AUKUS is further evidence of the strength of the Canberra-Washington relationship.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b7bac12b-bd33-4ca5-af26-a4024c0cda81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
US Secretary of Defense Lloyd J. Austin III meets with British Secretary of State for Defense Ben Wallace and Australian Defense Minister Richard Marles at the Pentagon, Dec. 7, 2022. SOURCE: [https://www.defense.gov/Spotlights/AUKUS/](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3d1d19d4-72ee-4ef3-9df8-364d15305ccf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For decades, Australia has also benefited economically alongside the rise of China, as the Middle Kingdom voraciously consumed billions of dollars worth of commodities. In fact, China remains Australia's largest trading partner today, importing iron ore and coal as well as precious metals and agricultural products. But it's not just commodities that China is buying. The country has also been aggressively purchasing Australian assets.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z-rYEVFsEzVJpEByLkAyVNopmJXmFq2W7hyrLo76SOw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136279018)
[A 2022 review of Chinese activity in Australia](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/37cf8139-4a7e-459c-b895-047e719a1a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) provided a concise summary: "Between 2007 and 2021, China's state-owned enterprises and private companies poured a total of $158 billion into Australia." Chinese companies have purchased [mines](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/94e77bd4-f50b-47b1-be9c-a953d74d2dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [electricity generation assets](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/28bae5ee-e18c-4983-b5ac-e69af6b30235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the rights to operate major ports such as [Darwin](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9b3b63fd-7f37-4f4d-a84b-6e208d6ec576?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Newcastle](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fab7a5de-ce12-4c1c-af14-bbac1c1c9e9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [agricultural land](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e88b87ea-dc78-4ae9-85f8-3791d2204ac8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [dairy processors](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ed8de5f7-0ecd-444c-87db-c2c9a4c0fea9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and even the [rights to water](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e8fd158c-73ee-412b-8b2a-8ebb9b18504a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). According to Government reports, [China now owns 2.3% of Australia's farmland](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/49196705-3316-4e47-8c29-290489753c74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [about 1.5% of Australian water entitlements](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dcaa7fa9-e7ea-4d7a-b01e-88c7057468bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c60ac866-857d-4552-b2a3-210134ddcd23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://ntindependent.com.au/landbridge-groups-managing-director-stands-down-amid-security-review-of-darwin-port/](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/57b144c6-4623-49c1-a307-57234590658d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For years, the global community has encouraged such economic entanglement with China, theorizing that a more prosperous Beijing would politically drift towards democracy and become a responsible member of the rules-based international world order. The opposite has transpired, as [China has hijacked multilateral institutions, consistently violated human rights expectations, failed to protect property rights, and used economic coercion to compel political compliance](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bef922af-a1ef-4ab3-bb44-53a3c230edb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Australia is now squarely in China's crosshairs.
Consider Beijing's reaction to Canberra's 2020 request for an independent inquiry into the origins of COVID19, an investigation that would have threatened China's narrative of the outbreak and its source. [China exercised their enormous economic leverage over Australia to impose a A$24bn (equivalent to 5.5% of exports) hit to Australia's economy by massively slowing imports of barley, wine, timber, coal, and even lobsters](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6b016e80-e321-4884-8f1e-b10713565117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But as _The Economist_ eloquently described in 2023, Australia "[did not succumb. And like a surfer surviving a shark attack with no more than a lightly gnawed board, Australia is now emerging from three years of Chinese bullying in remarkably good shape](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6b016e80-e321-4884-8f1e-b10713565117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f5f5cf8c-2ed6-49f4-a1d0-62d2a1dfd303?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Actually, China has had its crosshairs focused on Australia for a while. Specifically, it has been targeting the country since August 2004 when CCP secretary Hu Jintao declared that Australia was part of China's "overall periphery." Given Beijing's long term security concerns about its periphery, this designation spurred a ton of effort. Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Zhou Wenzhong visited Australia shortly thereafter and convened a meeting of senior PRC officials working and high level ministry staff. The inclusion of Australia, it was argued, was essential to develop a reliable supply source of inputs needed to power China's economic development over the next twenty years. _**The longer term goal was to drive a wedge between the United States and Australia.**_ By 2005, Beijing had begun what Clive Hamilton later referred to as "a systematic campaign to infiltrate, influence and control the most important institutions in Australia."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z-rYEVFsEzVJpEByLkAyVNopmJXmFq2W7hyrLo76SOw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136279018)
How do we know this? Because Chen Yonglin, who at the time was First Secretary for Political Affairs at the PRC Consulate in Sydney, was at that meeting and shortly thereafter sought political asylum in Australia. He summarized his thoughts in a 2016 piece entitled "[Australia as China's Backyard](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2db0f3d8-8a75-4625-8d6e-aeb25cb49834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." In it, he describes the four primary reasons that China has targeted Australia: (1) it was the nearest major Western democratic ally with a relatively weak national power, (2) Australia had a sizable population of Chinese migrants, nationals, immigrants and others who had been ideologically exposed to CCP thinking and might be easily coerced, (3) it had multicultural policies that would allow for infiltration under the guise of cultural engagement, and (4) there was no "foreign agent registration act" that might impact trip up Chinese influence operations.
Chen's article notes that Australia was perhaps "[the earliest experimental base for the Chinese Communists in expanding their soft power abroad](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2db0f3d8-8a75-4625-8d6e-aeb25cb49834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." By at least one measure, the efforts have been working: [only 42% of Australians polled in 2023 said they would support "sending Australian military personnel to Taiwan to help defend it from China](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b9bbfdc1-2d09-4b10-ab06-5c7d7808721c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
To better understand the breadth and depth of Chinese efforts in Australia, I highly recommend Clive Hamilton's book _[Silent Invasion: China's Influence in Australia](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7ec91e06-2a5d-4cb1-b000-313a45e81508?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. The book was published in 2018 and ended with Hamilton calling for his country's leaders to effectively open their eyes and rethink what was happening:
> _There is a widespread view that China 's rise is unstoppable, that our economy's fate is in Beijing's hands, and that China's size means it must dominate Asia. So it's best if we go along with this historical inevitability, because we don't really have any choice, and it won't be such a bad thing anyway. So we pursue 'friendship and cooperation,' **accept the flood of money, sell our assets, jump when China 's diplomats shout, look the other way when our technology is funneled offshore, recruit Beijing's agents into our political system, stay silent on human rights abuses, and sacrifice basic values like free and open inquiry in our universities**....Has there every been a greater betrayal by our elites?_
Within a couple of years of the book's publication, Professor Hamilton's views were becoming more common. In a 2019 paper titled "[The future of the US-Australia Alliance in an Era of Great Power Competition](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2f9a2ff3-487c-4471-a584-df1fede1f089?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" published by the [United States Study Center](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0741fd23-616b-4ee1-97d5-b7c824fb4378?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Dr. Charles Edel and Dr. John Lee note China's ultimate objective is the establishment of a Sino-centric Indo-Pacific. They further highlight that Beijing is pursuing this goal by "[diluting the credibility, effectiveness, and relevance of US alliances in Asia, while simultaneously undercutting the will of Washington's regional allies to accept the risks and costs associated with countering growing Chinese power](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2f9a2ff3-487c-4471-a584-df1fede1f089?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z-rYEVFsEzVJpEByLkAyVNopmJXmFq2W7hyrLo76SOw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136279018)
A more pressing issue, however, may be China's [rapidly slowing economy](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f8332d60-0f1c-455a-9284-9ab560f87833?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [China's youth are increasingly disillusioned](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3b9afd2f-c121-41ac-9909-95b0a7642beb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with their future prospects, there are almost [35 million more males than females](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8f4579ff-df2c-45a7-95d4-2352f348540d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [frustration with the Chinese Communist Party has been rising since the COVID lockdowns](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/78f1112b-543d-42d8-815f-3877ea66ad4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The pressures building on Beijing are enormous. Might the situation spur the CCP to accelerate its plans to militarily "reintegrate" Taiwan as it seeks to divert attention away from domestic economic malaise? Should this happen, I suspect it would lead to [greater US-Australia cooperation and a stronger alliance](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd228ef6-fa63-419e-970f-8238486fa3db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Just like the global approach to politically reform China via economic inclusion, China's strategy of putting a wedge between the United States and Australia seems to have backfired. The [mateship](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/238121a0-a53e-4d51-88b0-09c4bcb663bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) would likely emerge stronger.
While the AUKUS agreement and Australia's resilience in the face of Chinese economic coercion provide evidence of a strong US-Australia alliance, [China's recent activity on the Solomon Islands](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bb81e306-dcf7-435d-8e95-b6c0d1f64563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has raised eyebrows, specifically its establishment of a [comprehensive strategic partnership](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3dcb9cce-ee80-4959-bbf7-0b62dc7cd4f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The history here is relevant. During WWII, the battle for Guadalcanal, the largest of the Solomon Islands, was a major turning point where Allied forces stopped Japanese expansionism. The islands are among the most strategic in the Indo-Pacific region, which is why [China ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bb81e306-dcf7-435d-8e95-b6c0d1f64563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[de facto](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bb81e306-dcf7-435d-8e95-b6c0d1f64563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ controlling them ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bb81e306-dcf7-435d-8e95-b6c0d1f64563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)is so concerning. They are also close to Australia.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/01e313ce-1c9e-4d6e-a520-d6a5bf562dbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Surprise and deception are deeply embedded elements of Chinese military philosophy. Recall the [36 Stratagems](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75af9228-4e24-4660-83a3-e2cb59e270e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Strategy #6 (**Sh ēng dōng jī xī) **is loosely translated as "Make a sound in the East, then strike in the West" and is about attacking where least expected.
Is it possible that China is making a sound in Taiwan but planning to strike elsewhere?Might Beijing be more interested in securing needed raw materials that reunifying with Taiwan? Could Australia actually be China's target? As previously noted, the country has a large population of ethnic Chinese, ports that are managed by Chinese companies, and many of the energy and agriculture resources needed to fuel Chinese expansionism. Has China's "[silent invasion](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ae980012-8bac-488c-afe6-b2b17ae4072f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" of Australia over the past fifteen years laid the groundwork for more visible action?
While it's impossible to know Beijing's intentions or plans, it would be imprudent to only focus where they've directed our attention. _**As the noise around Taiwan gets louder, it 's worth looking [Down Under](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9f5bff42-c90c-43f0-ab22-f15ab4bc6dbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to see where China may possibly strike.**_

Given Beijing's long term security concerns about its periphery, this designation spurred a ton of effort. Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Zhou Wenzhong visited Australia shortly thereafter and convened a meeting of senior PRC officials working and high level ministry staff. The inclusion of Australia, it was argued, was essential to develop a reliable supply source of inputs needed to power China's economic development over the next twenty years. The longer term goal was to drive a wedge between the United States and Australia. By 2005, Beijing had begun what Clive Hamilton later referred to as "a systematic campaign to infiltrate, influence and control the most important institutions in Australia." How do we know this? Because Chen Yonglin, who at the time was First Secretary for Political Affairs at the PRC Consulate in Sydney, was at that meeting and shortly thereafter sought political asylum in Australia. He summarized his thoughts in a 2016 piece entitled "." In it, he describes the four primary reasons that China has targeted Australia: (1) it was the nearest major Western democratic ally with a relatively weak national power, (2) Australia had a sizable population of Chinese migrants, nationals, immigrants and others who had been ideologically exposed to CCP thinking and might be easily coerced, (3) it had multicultural policies that would allow for infiltration under the guise of cultural engagement, and (4) there was no "foreign agent registration act" that might impact trip up Chinese influence operations. Chen's article notes that Australia was perhaps "." By at least one measure, the efforts have been working: ." To better understand the breadth and depth of Chinese efforts in Australia, I highly recommend Clive Hamilton's book . The book was published in 2018 and ended with Hamilton calling for his country's leaders to effectively open their eyes and rethink what was happening: There is a widespread view that China 's rise is unstoppable, that our economy's fate is in Beijing's hands, and that China's size means it must dominate Asia. So it's best if we go along with this historical inevitability, because we don't really have any choice, and it won't be such a bad thing anyway. So we pursue 'friendship and cooperation,' accept the flood of money, sell our assets, jump when China 's diplomats shout, look the other way when our technology is funneled offshore, recruit Beijing's agents into our political system, stay silent on human rights abuses, and sacrifice basic values like free and open inquiry in our universities....Has there every been a greater betrayal by our elites? Within a couple of years of the book's publication, Professor Hamilton's views were becoming more common. In a 2019 paper titled "" published by the , Dr. Charles Edel and Dr. John Lee note China's ultimate objective is the establishment of a Sino-centric Indo-Pacific. They further highlight that Beijing is pursuing this goal by "." A more pressing issue, however, may be China's . with their future prospects, there are almost , and . The pressures building on Beijing are enormous. Might the situation spur the CCP to accelerate its plans to militarily "reintegrate" Taiwan as it seeks to divert attention away from domestic economic malaise? Should this happen, I suspect it would lead to . Just like the global approach to politically reform China via economic inclusion, China's strategy of putting a wedge between the United States and Australia seems to have backfired. The would likely emerge stronger. While the AUKUS agreement and Australia's resilience in the face of Chinese economic coercion provide evidence of a strong US-Australia alliance, has raised eyebrows, specifically its establishment of a . The history here is relevant. During WWII, the battle for Guadalcanal, the largest of the Solomon Islands, was a major turning point where Allied forces stopped Japanese expansionism. The islands are among the most strategic in the Indo-Pacific region, which is why so concerning. They are also close to Australia. Surprise and deception are deeply embedded elements of Chinese military philosophy. Recall the . Strategy #6 (Sh ēng dōng jī xī) is loosely translated as "Make a sound in the East, then strike in the West" and is about attacking where least expected. Is it possible that China is making a sound in Taiwan but planning to strike elsewhere?Might Beijing be more interested in securing needed raw materials that reunifying with Taiwan? Could Australia actually be China's target? As previously noted, the country has a large population of ethnic Chinese, ports that are managed by Chinese companies, and many of the energy and agriculture resources needed to fuel Chinese expansionism. Has China's "" of Australia over the past fifteen years laid the groundwork for more visible action? While it's impossible to know Beijing's intentions or plans, it would be imprudent to only focus where they've directed our attention. As the noise around Taiwan gets louder, it 's worth looking to see where China may possibly strike. subject: Can I loop you in?
body:
I knew it wouldn’t be easy

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21002%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fvzWHEjFgUVFEZj%2fRwR%2bSg&sysid=1 "New Message From: Riley Gaines")

_**[Friend, my name is Riley Gaines, and I want to loop you into my mission to SAVE women’s sports with the help of Senator Marsha Blackburn.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21003%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8OQDPV%2f0I9ZVUB1vbN1a%2fw&sysid=1 "Friend, my name is Riley
Gaines, and I want to loop you into my mission to SAVE women’s sports with the
help of Senator Marsha Blackburn. ")**_

I grew up swimming and was blessed to receive a scholarship to the University of Kentucky. It was all a dream come true... _Until it wasn’t._

When a 6’4 male walked into our locker room. Myself and other young women were expected to carry on business as usual, but I didn’t stand for it.

I immediately left the locker room and asked a pool official how it was allowed to happen. I was told they “got around that,” and it was okay. **That’s where my outrage began.**

Any man, coach, or official could have full access by making the locker rooms unisex. We weren’t warned. We were subjected. And to rub salt into the wound, I was forced to share a podium with Lia Thomas, a biological male, at the NCAA championship.

I’ve experienced the fear. I’ve experienced the sadness. I’ve experienced what Democrats think is “no big deal.” And now, because I didn’t stand for it and spoke up for women and girls everywhere, I have a target on my back.

Unfortunately for them, it has only empowered me. _**[My mission to save women’s sports has become bigger than I ever imagined. The American people are waking up and seeing that what’s happening in women’s sports is only the beginning.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21004%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ReQt%2bqKQImWbnyoL5ptfnQ&sysid=1 "My mission to save women’s
sports has become bigger than I ever imagined. The American people are waking up
and seeing that what’s happening in women’s sports is only the beginning.")**_

The woke, transgender agenda won’t stop.

I refuse to let this journey end. I refuse to bow down because they want me to. _**[I’m asking you today to stand with me and Marsha Blackburn to SAVE women’s sports.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21015%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ki5hF075c6roxUEOMtMVEQ&sysid=1 "I’m asking you today to
stand with me and Marsha Blackburn to SAVE women’s sports.")**_

Can I count on you?

Thank you,

Riley

name: 1600 Daily
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmtb436rn9rhlvftrjqaplgj9s4i9j1v83j6qeco_rp22sh2s8i66p72ctg60oj2cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhiv7k897gsmrdl5u0mo17fk8a34tejf5m77mg3g_rp22sh2s8i66p72ctg60oj2cdh2bs) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkqp7ieu28qgjkn1e77jd16nve9c2btst8kjpjb0_rp22sh2s8i66p72ctg60oj2cdh2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

## South California Hit with Record Rain
Los Angeles was hit with record rainfall from [Tropical Storm Hilary](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNkfmzmAzMHTJlq4d0cU-w1UGI2Mlzd9X6dzx6S1P7-s230iS7MsnbTzVmGfyVR48a6cAFOAMbZgiMzC2PHXDCFajcbpdp9G7e4z2DgZNHMkNhNgFj2aEgXo7tjKBBtQOQI9o0V0ceDs433VogDmYxmgOUnO5fGfZ68oxvfKDy8XnrU3TWutxNvjRwLWBKx07P8-3ekOp4hM3cK0lH-IpqbPmsqlVEpWXSvlUtC-c-FSeksRcdiG18Y_4rGLKOci-KOi97f2dIHhLTNgNuh84xhDHDl1n2zKF4ykpyTnYxuhlI0l_dfX_Wb8BAAD__wJda48) as Southern California wrestled with flooded roads, mudslides, and downed trees. A stretch of the I-10 freeway was closed. The storm dumped heavy rain from the Mexico border up through Las Vegas and beyond. One of the [worst hit communities was Palm Springs,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSsyAUBeCnwQ4HLkRJQfE3dvnbLR0Cl8gOSuaCcXz7Hbfe9pzmO-frMT9cyml7_Xcr2hbL7HxLH5yF4QAc1AxdsBERUHVo5XCHUShtRLdYLbT0z-jD-JQi6OFmUEgfIwYl3G0MXbIgQAkDIO5qVKY34MfBeCmVBsSgmRYYUivUf5e0tQVjPssHqfdl7bJdWntXpv4xmBhMx3H0hHtDqld_JYVyYDDtlcHUqLyTd5nXVmjlS8qOTk6Y0VWsPO508lr2tiBt3LucYqEtOX4R-bVWMpg6suF9pJxTHUamxWt1Kf9q2t_n_AQAAP__7Llm0A) where streets were flooded by debris flows, blocking traffic in and out of town. The area was also hit by an earthquake over the weekend and rocked by continuing after-shocks through Monday. This morning, Hilary is [headed toward Oregon and Idaho,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd1h44BlSULzGXbbd0prgIcwKQ4TZWPn7Vbbe7kpXOjo6n9f1ipy53D9wJ99jXTF0ftKqnASQoFcYNh-JgPRAfpovYJU2Tg3J23m-obH_yADiRU-oIN4mPQerwISIA3tQoJUDUBdttRsdBDu7ME3aANFmhFG0ca9t_KpceqKYX_VJbQx1H7JPvT8Oof8LWAQs53mOodzC-xSwvNECFuXeexKw9FYfHDDLo9e2y8QZ20tujUpIdMijfvdErciAmWNthXFMfc9D89vj5Jz5mK0w6r4j51-B_nePnwAAAP__WfVhGg) with more rain expected.
## Nations Line Up in New Race to the Moon
A race for the moon's resources has begun, with the U.S., China, India, Russia, Japan, and even private companies [vying for lunar dominance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGuozAQheGnMd0gewwxFBTb0GXbLdHEHoNXBke2CcrbXyX1rY-O9Ov7d1_uFGI41r-081R9WsjW8OJFDoAIqBds3OSZkXXDk7qNaKTuBtlsk-n60ShjeqW4V4YsOzLkPHe9Gx_jowkTStRyQJSjNnpoB7TmNlildIfMrhOdZBdqyu3_FI66sY_v9OLc2rQ3cdpqfRah_wicBc7XdbWZz8q5fHaBc2W7HSmm9S1wLk-yLHDOZBn2lA7IXNKZLRfYqMCD1_OAQu8C-SwlUIHvBewW2AP5yhk8hcgO4nlQhk88fByUwLnJk3teIcZQbkZ0ct0pxG9n_Z3tJwAA___Z6m_L) in a competition not seen since the era of the Cold War. Russian space officials made it clear that they weren't giving up despite the crash of their lunar vehicle this weekend. "This is about ensuring defensive capabilities," said the head of Russia's space effort. All eyes now are on India, set to land on the moon's south pole tomorrow. Its lander is already [sending back photos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHS2yAQhJ8GdWjQIUuioEijzmlTas5wWJdB4AFsTd4-I9d_u7vFt9-f-3ZHjpyev_Eg20Le0DX-0KYWCSBBb9B5G4iAdEd2mAzMSo-L6nYLs_HBBG9ImdvNUTAPjQNimAc_ef_o2IICrRYAZfSsl34BN0-LGwY9ApEfxajIc8ul_5s5tZ1C_Jc_VHqXjy7avbVXFfqXgFXAep5nX-jdqNSrv5JcohewcvKMAtYj5yQjJs_pKTE1dvzCxjnJx5ujr_I7lBgaFVnetTJW6QrWXV6g8vo8CFi7Yv3r5Bi5TrMY1fNAjl-m9rOi_wEAAP__yX1pIg). That's just the beginning: NASA's Artemis 3 mission is set to return humans to the moon in 2025, and China plans to begin building a base on the moon in 2030. [Here's a list of the various moon missions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FugzAQANCvsTeQuTsZM3jowpauHZFjH3CVsSOwEuXvq3buDzzpfd2WW5AsZfsMB_u21iXEJk9ejOsAOsAFdPIrMzBq9oOdYDRIzujdB6T7CneXogk4RLDTwLTaOCZLiWjS4sEAGgdgJhzR9Q7iaF0cBiRgTqTIcJJWz_67Smk7r_ldn3z2sR46-721x6XwQ8GsYH7s76uv56ZgLvy6FMy_emdct0korTtqLf3ejqxPnx4vyVkuOyoy2xEk_5Ht_-FPAAAA__967FCY).
## All Movie Tickets Only $4 This Sunday
National Cinema Day returns for a second year this Sunday, with all movie tickets [costing only $4 each](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu2zAMRb_G3hTIpGLJg4cu2dK1oyGTVMJWlgJbTZC_f8ib33hxh3Nw_lyXa9Ss5fY7bjK3VJdITZ-y2GAADOACPc9JBAR7mYdxAm_RBdvfZ7aJ12FKAYTJi_MYzyNxsEPiMYZzrzNYQBsA7IQewykA-THQMKADEXads8La6n76W7W0u6T8rk_ZT1S3Ps_31h5Hh786uHRwiY8ir-NzfcbelLJ0cCmxaS0xG9IiWzQc3-aDNawH1f-lCZum9E_aYSwiJS9nP6KdHDvCdR0mZsIVR4LU7zM_XpqzHqPvnL1tUfO3TPu5zVcAAAD__8wKZHI) at more than 3,000 locations or approximately 30,000 screens across the U.S. The goal is to [fill movie seats during the final dog days](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQhX-N2RyZM2AzeOjClq4dkWMfybXGjvCFiH9f0bnT09OTnj59X9f56ilRvn_6FR0vZfaBacdZWQkgQc_QRLcgAuoGXTuMYJTurGoeDqMP7dhjtDboG6LVYG869EM_QjfaviEHCrSyAGrURtuLhWAGG9pWd4AYO9EpjMRlu3wXyvzAJR1lx-0Sytok92B-VqE_BEwCpt1vhHycm4DpfBYwLZTOlvFdz_BMJfskA2VcvYz-kBvya8tVrmUnlEzhB7nKSDWUV2aMsgXdG6WMsQKmZnPx-aaUqA5GdOq-ekp_OPy_nd8AAAD__y_DZTo) of summer. The summer box office is 16.6% ahead of 2022, thanks mainly to "Barbie" and "Oppenheimer," but still 5.4% below 2019. Last year's inaugural National Cinema Day was the highest-attended day for the movies in 2022, which meant theater owners sold a lot of concession treats -- where their real money is made.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: Co-Parenting with Colorado: A War on Kids' Healthcare
body:
Episode #18 of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl is LIVE!
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ayhjlul-tkwdjuidt-r/) Hi Peter, America's woke indoctrination is happening everywhere: in education, healthcare, politics, and in the private sector. This week on Unleashed, I focus on how our kids' healthcare has been weaponized in this culture war.When my daughter turned 14 a couple of weeks ago, I received an email from her pediatric office that I was not allowed to see her medical records anymore, because of her age - except for the bill, of course. When I called them to ask why they were doing this - they blamed it on federal HIPAA law. BUT there is no law that requires them to cut parents out at age 14, they were lying.Knowledge is power, and that's why I'm bringing you the FACTS in this week's episode...
➡️ What HIPAA actually says about accessing your child's medical records
➡️ The onerous Colorado state laws, including some new ones, that are radical and aggressively eliminating parents' rights
➡️ California legislation that Polis is bringing to Colorado
➡️ The rights parents have RIGHT NOW to protect your kids' education and wellbeing, and how to protect themI detailed out very specific tactics and questions to ask your schools & doctor's offices at the end of the episode. You can also see them listed out on my Substack **[HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ayhjlul-tkwdjuidt-y/)**. I'm also joined by Holly Calvert, a Colorado mom fighting for health freedom and parental rights.
### **Episode #18 - CO-PARENTING WITH COLORADO:
A WAR ON KIDS' HEALTHCARE**

I post transcripts of my monologues and full episode breakdowns every week on my Substack.[You can subscribe here!](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ayhjlul-tkwdjuidt-k/)_

our message and solutions are what are going to revive our
nation, but my personal investment can only get us so far. To
keep this going and actually impact change, I need you to join me
and put some skin in the game with me.

This isn't just a political
campaign, but a cultural movement. It's about the unapologetic

purpose as citizens.

As I have traveled the country,
I'm more convinced than ever that our best days are actually,
truly - not in some cheesy politician kind of way - but actually
ahead of us. That we are not in some inevitable national decline.

your donation. I am looking for lots of donations from

**Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy is running against one of Chuck Schumer’s**
**foot soldiers in the Senate who votes to deliver the Biden-Harris**
**agenda of open borders and big government spending that fuels the**
**fires of inflation. And Tim needs OUR HELP to win.**
You see, Jon Tester has successfully pulled the wool over voters’ eyes into
sending him to Washington on their behalf since 2006. How, I don’t know.

**Let’s put an end to Democrats representing conservative states in**

make sure you click this link to donate to help Navy Seal Tim Sheehy WIN

Dear Peter - Thanks to your impassioned support, we're breaking through ballot access barriers across the country! All together we're now actively petitioning in 9 states, about to start in 9 more, and already on the ballot in 18. Hundreds of volunteers are hard at work and mobilizing.
In South Dakota, for example, the Indigenous-led petition drive is leading the charge for the nation, inspiring us all. These intrepid petitioners are more than half way to our goal of 7000 signatures.
In Arizona, however, we are facing some of the most repressive, anti-democratic ballot access barriers in the nation. name: Al Canata
subject: IRS Misdeeds to Tax Court EXPOSED!
body:
We know the IRS doesn't play fair with taxpayers.

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21123%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dWooxILiGtzHuxUhfEfnug&sysid=1)

Hello Friend,

We all know how taxes work. The IRS loves to demand paperwork for everything. And it all needs to be filled out and signed correctly... or else.

_But what happens when the IRS fails to file its own paperwork correctly? Or worse, what happens when the IRS backdates a document**and lies about it to a court**?_

So far, nothing...

But growing pressure may change that. That’s why I’m emailing you today. I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union Foundation (NTUF).

Our Taxpayer Defense Center (TDC) engages in litigation to protect taxpayers from overzealous, unfair tax administration.

[We know the IRS doesn’t play fair with taxpayers. But the TDC is there to even the odds. Will you empower the Taxpayer Defense Center to defend taxpayers in court against the IRS? Please click below to show your support.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21124%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y7o1%2f79YZVpvKfYLDjctXw&sysid=1)
[Donate >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21135%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WHNwYiE%2fKfKM1lvwuxBmwA&sysid=1)
All of this has to do with a requirement put in place by the Internal Revenue Service Restructuring and Reform Act of 1998 (the direct result of important work led by NTU in highlighting IRS enforcement abuses and the need for reforms) which requires an IRS supervisor to review and approve, with their signature, any imposition of tax penalties.

**Simply put, no supervisor signature, no penalties.**

But it turns out that the IRS wasn’t following this requirement.

The Lakepoint Land Group uncovered evidence that the IRS backdated the supervisor’s signature and then obstructed attempts to find out when the supervisor even signed the document.

Lakepoint then filed a lawsuit when the IRS dragged its feet on the Freedom of Information Act request for documents related to the incident.

**This is just one example of the IRS applying a double standard, giving themselves an advantage over taxpayers at every turn.**

But as more revelations like this appear in courts, the easier it is for the Taxpayer Defense Center to identify and engage in the cases that are the most likely to have a positive and lasting impact on taxpayers’ rights.

**Your generous support will help NTUF’s Taxpayer Defense Center win more victories against the IRS. Click below to donate today.**

[Donate $10 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21136%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xZ2qayOUGKOONCi3igFWQA&sysid=1)

[Donate $35 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21137%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iloVnINEwUSjySoiZmWFgA&sysid=1)

[Donate $50 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21138%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a7X0NVmKkFS24vKwui46dw&sysid=1)

[Donate $100 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21139%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1B1boNaVQzvKXkZuPP0CCA&sysid=1)

[Donate $250 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21130%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=No8x464ojayqj10b%2bTEjOQ&sysid=1)

[Donate $500 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21131%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=siz%2fT2TbSAmFcWx3WqLeTw&sysid=1)

[Donate $1,000 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21132%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FK6NI%2fKi1Q2XP%2btqgL7e6Q&sysid=1)

[Donate Any Amount >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21133%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nWeSPSonw7FJJc4wsxOorA&sysid=1)

The Taxpayer Defense Center has already beaten the IRS in court.

**NTUF launched the Taxpayer Defense Center in 2020, and since then, we’ve already made a powerful impact in these cases:**
* In Boechler v. Commissioner, NTUF’s amicus brief in support of Boechler elicited a very rare response from the United States solicitor general. We argued that tax collection would not be severely harmed if the IRS’s unrealistic position was struck down. The Supreme Court would rule 9-0 against the IRS.

* In Oakbrook Holdings v. Commissioner, the Center was the only public interest litigation group filing a brief in this Sixth Circuit case involving the IRS. Our brief argued that the IRS’s shifting position on regulations had put taxpayers who wanted to follow the law in an impossible situation. We have laid the groundwork for future challenges to the government’s contradictory behavior.

* And in CIC Services v. Internal Revenue Service, the IRS has long hidden behind the Anti-Injunction Act to prevent taxpayers from taking the tax agency to court. In this case, the unanimous Supreme Court decision said that there are limits to the IRS’s defense, opening the door to more challenges from taxpayers. We filed in support of the plaintiff’s position in that case, which was also decided on a 9-0 ruling against the IRS.

Even more recently, our efforts during the Fiscal Responsibility Act (FRA) helped to trim some of the IRS’ newfound largesse.

[And with your generous donation of $100, $50, $35, or even just $10, you can help NTUF’s Taxpayer Defense Center continue to win victories on behalf of the taxpayer. Click here to send your gift today >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21134%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Xc618a2RYqBGpwOCdtQGkw&sysid=1)

Thank you,

Al Canata
Vice President of Strategic Partnerships
National Taxpayers Union

_NTUF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, nonpartisan citizen group whose members work every day for lower taxes and smaller government at all levels._

---|---|---

| | **ENDANGERED SPECIES ALERT >> We need 82 more signatures from your state to help protect monarch butterflies from extinction! ** Monarchs officially reached endangered species status according to the International Union for the Conservation of Nature. Their rapid decline is due in large part to pesticides that kill milkweed – **the ONLY plant where monarchs lay their eggs. ** Grocery retailer **Kroger still sells food grown with the pesticides that are driving monarch populations to the brink.** Your message to Kroger can help change that – but we have to hurry! More milkweed is dying, pushing monarchs **closer to extinction every second we wait!** [**Friend, help SAVE endangered monarch butterflies from toxic pesticides before it’s too late!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1940849?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1940850?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
North American monarch populations have **crashed 90%** over the past few decades. These butterflies used to fill the autumn sky with stunning orange and black displays during their epic migrations. But **fewer and fewer monarchs are alive to make the journey** every year.
Kroger is the largest supermarket chain in the U.S. Friend, If you help us get a commitment from Kroger to stop selling food grown with pollinator-toxic pesticides, it could make a WORLD of difference for delicate monarchs. [**SEND YOUR MESSAGE TO KROGER: stop selling food grown with toxic pesticides!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1940851?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: | | | | | == ---|---|--- | | ENDANGERED SPECIES ALERT >> We need 82 more signatures from your state to help protect monarch butterflies from extinction! Monarchs officially reached endangered species status according to the International Union for the Conservation of Nature. Their rapid decline is due in large part to pesticides that kill milkweed – the ONLY plant where monarchs lay their eggs. Grocery retailer Kroger still sells food grown with the pesticides that are driving monarch populations to the brink. Your message to Kroger can help change that – but we have to hurry! More milkweed is dying, pushing monarchs closer to extinction every second we wait! == | == North American monarch populations have crashed 90% over the past few decades. These butterflies used to fill the autumn sky with stunning orange and black displays during their epic migrations. But fewer and fewer monarchs are alive to make the journey every year. Kroger is the largest supermarket chain in the U.S. Friend, If you help us get a commitment from Kroger to stop selling food grown with pollinator-toxic pesticides, it could make a WORLD of difference for delicate monarchs. == == Standing with you, Kendra Klein Deputy Director of Science, Friends of the Earth == == == | == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == Formatting canceled

All On The Line and Power the Polls is calling upon you to step up ahead of the election.
|
---

Hi Team,
In these times of change and challenge, the strength of our democracy hinges on each individual's commitment to making a difference. Our democracy works best when every voice is heard, every vote is counted, and every polling place is fully operational. And we're facing a challenge that could impact the very foundation of our elections, and we need your help.
* * *
**Election administrators are raising concerns that there won't be enough poll workers to ensure every polling place is properly staffed and open to voters in November. We can't let that happen. That’s why All On The Line and Power the Polls is calling upon you to step up ahead of the election.**
* * *
[**Join us for a special event on August 23rd as we celebrate Poll Worker Recruitment Day and discuss how poll workers play a pivotal role in safeguarding a safe, fair, and efficient election for all voters.**](https://www.mobilize.us/allontheline/event/575617?refcode=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite?utm_campaign=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite)
[REGISTER TODAY](https://www.mobilize.us/allontheline/event/575617?refcode=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite?utm_campaign=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite)
---
**Your Impact Amplified:** By becoming a poll worker, you're not just supporting the mechanics of the election; you're upholding the very essence of democracy. Your involvement can be the turning point in someone's ability to cast their ballot. **Join the Movement:** Be part of a nationwide movement that transcends political lines and unites us all in a shared commitment to the democratic process. Your actions can inspire others and shape the future of our nation. **Secure Our Elections:** As we face evolving challenges, your role as a poll worker is invaluable in ensuring that every voter's voice is heard, and every election reflects the will of the people. **Act Now:** Time is of the essence. Our democracy relies on volunteers like you to ensure its vitality. Join us on August 23rd and step into a role that can define the trajectory of our nation. | [Sign Up for Poll Worker Recruitment Day](https://www.mobilize.us/allontheline/event/575617?refcode=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite?utm_campaign=20230821_AOTL_O_PollWorkers_RedLite)

body:
Check out how your local Democrat State Representative Votes!

| | | | |
---
| | Derek,

Proud to share with you [VoteDemsOut.org](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.votedemsout.org%2F/1/0100018a1d1fc361-46f9fb9f-b946-4990-8121-5fb64de12fd4-000000/fhq9zXcLnR_0xr-x0P1wUeyqhVo=336) \- a new site built to hold New Hampshire House Democrats accountable for their votes and help expand our New Hampshire House Majority in 2024.
---
[](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.votedemsout.org%2F/2/0100018a1d1fc361-46f9fb9f-b946-4990-8121-5fb64de12fd4-000000/UXR2JQm-xUAGpriZI1hfzVuSByU=336)
---
[](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fopenwith.link%2FGraniteSolutions.org%2Fevents%2F1830.html/1/0100018a1d1fc361-46f9fb9f-b946-4990-8121-5fb64de12fd4-000000/TlhkheN1OvRpq3knSzFw4zdVUN0=336)On the homepage you will find a clickable county map and a search function to search for your local Democrat State Representatives. Each Democrat State Representative has a profile on the site with a handful of their most disastrous votes - we will be adding more over time to the site, but we are starting with key votes that nearly every House Democrat voted in lockstep on: Efforts to limits Educational Freedom, blocking Parental Rights, an attempt to raise taxes by over $100 Million in the last budget, and a vote against a bill that would have banned sanctuary cities in New Hampshire.

100% of the Democrats present in the Chamber voted to table the sanctuary cities bill and that list of Democrats is easily accessible here: [https://www.votedemsout.org/sanctuary-cities](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.votedemsout.org%2Fsanctuary-cities/1/0100018a1d1fc361-46f9fb9f-b946-4990-8121-5fb64de12fd4-000000/qIz32DTJ9RKfG9K5eSJ-r5kgDJE=336)

On each page constituents & activists will be able to email or call Democrat State Representatives if the Representative has an email or phone number on file. There will be additional votes added this year and more frequent additions added during next year's legislative session.

In the weeks ahead we will also be adding shareable graphics to the pages to make it easier to spread the word about what House Democrats are trying in New Hampshire and how we can best hold them accountable.

Best,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Chairman, Granite Solutions

subject: IRS Misdeeds to Tax Court EXPOSED!
body:
We know the IRS doesn't play fair with taxpayers.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdrooqllv4msqi3qfmeu3mo9cvnadb9b3i0oveco_rp22sh2s8i66p72cth68o76clh2bs)

Hello Friend,

We all know how taxes work. The IRS loves to demand paperwork for everything. And it all needs to be filled out and signed correctly... or else.

_But what happens when the IRS fails to file its own paperwork correctly? Or worse, what happens when the IRS backdates a document**and lies about it to a court**?_

So far, nothing...

But growing pressure may change that. That's why I'm emailing you today. I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union Foundation (NTUF).

Our Taxpayer Defense Center (TDC) engages in litigation to protect taxpayers from overzealous, unfair tax administration.

[We know the IRS doesn't play fair with taxpayers. But the TDC is there to even the odds. Will you empower the Taxpayer Defense Center to defend taxpayers in court against the IRS? Please click below to show your support.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhhfoqnlc3lai3llm9rcn58t318tvm20ki97cq4o_rp22sh2s8i66p72cth68o76clh2bs)
[Donate >>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3up2qsi2vjvgccm54ek7dgqlq0hipfsublta4eo_rp22sh2s8i66p72cth68o76clh2bs)
All of this has to do with a requirement put in place by the Internal Revenue Service Restructuring and Reform Act of 1998 (the direct result of important work led by NTU in highlighting IRS enforcement abuses and the need for reforms) which requires an IRS supervisor to review and approve, with their signature, any imposition of tax penalties.

**Simply put, no supervisor signature, no penalties.**

But it turns out that the IRS wasn't following this requirement.

The Lakepoint Land Group uncovered evidence that the IRS backdated the supervisor's signature and then obstructed attempts to find out when the supervisor even signed the document.

Romário (Río de Janeiro; 29 de Enero de 1966) es un exfutbolista Brasileño. Apodado en Brasil como O Baixinho ("El bajito"), En Argentina se lo conoce como “el chapulin” en realidad nada tiene que ver con el personaje de Roberto Gomez Bolaños. Ha sido uno de los futbolistas más goleadores de la historia a nivel mundial.
Por este motivo lo de Cappa es como una luz al final de un anden, nos da la esperanzas de volver a creer que el fútbol es un juego, pero no cualquier juego, es el mas lindo de todos, el que despierta tantos sentimientos buenos y malos, recuerdos imborrables en la vida de las personas pasando por la infancia, corriendo atrás de una pelotita quizás confeccionada de la forma mas humilde (con papeles de alfajores o medias) hasta llegar a la madurez de la vida de un hombre en una cancha de fútbol en el lugar que solo ocupan los socios vitalicios, aquellos que tienen mas de cincuenta años aportando a una institución de fútbol.

Before I start using the masking fluid, I always use this process to make the brush last longer. First dip your brush in water, then in liquid hand soap, and finally in the masking fluid. Keep up this process until you are finished using the masking fluid. Before putting the brush aside clean off any remaining masking fluid and wash with soap and water.

Nedvěd se caracterizaba por poseer un fuerte remate de larga distancia con ambas piernas desde cualquier posición del campo de juego y un buen remate de cabeza. Gracias a su baja estatura y su físico liviano le permitía tener una gran velocidad para adaptarse a la posición que le sea asignada dentro del campo. Sin embargo, la característica que más lo distinguía era jugar por la banda izquierda durante los noventa minutos.

body:
Ken Paxton’s impeachment trial begins in two weeks, and as Mr. Paxton’s Summer of Impeachment draws to a close, I want to share a piece I wrote. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas/jaworski-press-release-1-13860729?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=309bb23672&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | ,

Greetings! Ken Paxton’s impeachment trial begins in two weeks, and as Mr. Paxton’s Summer of Impeachment draws to a close, [**I want to share a piece I wrote recently for Meidas Touch**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=4501c25127&e=5d8d80652b) commenting on the upcoming trial.

Over the past month I’ve spoken to organizations across Texas on the topic, and I thank them for helping me organize my thoughts presented in the article. Special thanks to Texas Democratic Women - Galveston County, Galveston Island Democrats, Richardson Area Democrats, Tejano Democrats - Galveston County, Bexar County Democratic Party CEC, Texas Democratic County Chair Association and Rockwall County Democrats for inviting me to speak this summer.

Paxton’s impeachment trial will be live streamed on the [Texas Senate webpage](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=6d4df730bc&e=5d8d80652b) starting Tuesday, September 5th at 9am. Also, it’s an open hearing: The public may observe from the Senate Gallery, and the Senate Bailiff is tasked with organizing a method to allow the most number of citizens to enter the Gallery on a rotating basis.

I’ll be watching. Let me know you’re watching. I can be reached at joe@jaworskifortexas.com.

Onward!

Joe Jaworski

Peter,
My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it. Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Roland Gutierrez right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp]
When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter, we can take him down.
So please, I’m personally asking: Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Roland Gutierrez today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp]
Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.
With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and _win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

#### Good Morning Republicans,

As I read our NEGOP constitution, a clear definition is outlined of the actions and administration that is foundational to the success and growth of the party. The constitution has and will always be a framework, the structural strength of a bridge designed to hold all who wish to stand together. Upon this framework, solidly fastened by years of truth and revolution is our Platform planks etched with our values and principles. Some of these planks are severely beaten up from the constant attempts to rip them out because some believe we could LOSE an election if we stand firm on them. If our only goal was to not lose elections this bridge built for truth and justice would have so many gaps, many members would surely fall. Most of all, what bridge is secure or stable without a firm foundation built on Faith? We must purposely choose to see goodness and work towards being the light at all times or our values will bear no fruit. _Nebraska State Republican Party Constitution
PREAMBLE _ _That our beloved Republic may have the best and most just government and the freest and happiest people of all time, the Republican Party of Nebraska pledges and dedicates itself: _ _To oppose dictators and dictatorships, bureaucrats and bureaucracy; to maintain and continue Constitutional government in our State and Nation; to make sure that our government is one of laws and not of men; and that the laws enacted by the representatives of a free people through the unrestricted exercise of the ballot shall be justly administered and impartially enforced; to perpetuate the spirit of free enterprise; to make the opportunities of succeeding generations greater and better than those of the past; to decrease the burdens imposed by and the expenses incurred in government; to defend at any and all times, in both peace and war, our long established institutions of liberty against attacks from foreign and domestic threats; to the end that our government shall be truly and in fact a “government of the people, by the people, and for the people.” _ _ARTICLE I _ _Name and Objectives _ _Section 1. The name of this organization shall be the Republican Party of Nebraska. _ _Section 2. The objectives of the Party shall be the maintenance of government of, by and for the people according to the Constitution and laws of the United States and the State of Nebraska, and the furtherance of such principles as may from time to time be adopted. _ _ARTICLE II _ _Membership _ _Section 1. The membership of the Party shall be composed of all the registered Republican voters of the State of Nebraska who desire to support the objectives of the Party._ The biggest question of all is...who will be willing to work, and work tirelessly, to stand on this bridge of values/principles, this bridge of truth, and at the same time find ways to reach out to others? The work to do this can only come from constant, proactive, measured communication with a desire to have success for all and credit by none. We cannot serve others and at the same time be monument builders or seekers of a legacy. We cannot follow a path that is laid before us if we seek the treasures of this world. We can only believe that through our gifts and talents His will can and will be done. As we turn our focus to political paradigms and searching for solutions, I believe we will not be successful when we politicize each other versus humanize. I believe the more time spent listening and understanding the human components, or qualities in others, the greater chance we can further our principles. I would add a qualifying geographic component to the objective of “the furtherance of such principles” by saying “the furtherance of such principles within our community”. This means that we must focus locally, where we can make the most impact. From within our local communities we can further principles such as Education. Stay tuned for a series of focus and discussion on our principles as well as events and Roundtables to bring a unifying message of what we stand for Here are excerpts from our Platform on Education: Plank: Education _The Nebraska Republican Party reaffirms the role of education in the development of effective and responsible citizens._ _We believe that decisions regarding the education of children properly belong to parents and guardians. We reaffirm our belief that control of all aspects of public education should rest with local school boards, not state or federal agencies. We believe each student should be provided with the opportunity for an excellent academic education. We believe moral training based on principles established by God, under whom we profess to be a nation, should be returned to its proper and traditional place in the public schools. We urge citizens to require fiscal and educational accountability from policy makers, educational institutions, and educational professionals to assure that quality services are being rendered._ _We support statewide assessments of educational achievement and the administration of the ACT or SAT to all Nebraska 11th-graders. We oppose testing to identify physical, psychological, emotional or developmental disabilities without parental consent. We recognize and commend the dedicated educators and administrators who strive to prepare the students for future decision making that will directly affect the freedom and security of the United States._ _We encourage patriotism, respect for the American flag and an understanding of our nation’s ideals, which make our form of government the best in the world._ _We believe the family to be our country’s basic institution and as such should be encouraged to take a larger, not smaller, role in education. We support parental choice in education based on a program of vouchers or tax credits, thus creating better education through the principles of free market competition. These alternatives should include private, parochial and home schools._ _We believe that all schools and educators, whether public, private, or home school, be recognized for their contributions to the future of our state. _ _We support the right of parents to personally observe all classroom instruction and activities. We strongly support the teaching of the scientific, biologically verifiable X and Y chromosomal definition of male and female at birth, and the use of locker rooms, sports team qualifications, and restrooms based on the same definition._
With much blessings,

## Spotlight Feature: From Rep Kathleen Kauth
---
| You have heard it said before, but this was an historic legislative session. Not just because we passed significant Income Tax, Property Tax, and Social Security tax legislation, legislation to provide for our public schools and to offer opportunity for poor children to change their educational circumstances, we protected children from experimental, irreversible gender altering procedures and babies after 12 weeks from death.

My fellow freshmen Senators and I started our political careers out in what has been described as the most toxic environment on the legislative floor ever. I can't tell you how many times I was told "This has never happened before!" What we know from this experience is that politics is rough, but we are strong enough to take it. The left uses hate, nasty rhetoric, temper tantrums and obstruction of the legislative process to get what they want. This year - they did not succeed.

I'm very proud of all we got done, not just in spite of, but because of those leftist tactics. We banded together because our opponents were so blatantly attacking us, our values and our constituents. Although we do not always agree, there is a tremendous amount of respect among the conservative legislators on the floor.

Now as we head into the next election cycle we are facing very angry opponents who are calling in lots of money from out of state. We need to work together across the state to identify and support conservative candidates for office. Where there are multiple conservatives running for a single office - I would encourage anyone who doesn't make it through the primary to throw their support behind their fellow conservative who moves through to the general. Conservative leadership is the goal.

Our elections have been under attack as well. This summer Seth Paulson, Brian Kruse (Douglas County Election Commissioner) and I met with Wayne Bena from the Secretary of State's office to discuss creating a means to have volunteer observers watching the hand audits of the election. This will give us either more confidence in the accuracy of the machines, or verifiable data of inconsistencies. We will be putting together a pilot program, and implement it for the May 2024 elections. Stay tuned for more information as we develop this program.

Our party in Nebraska is in the midst of change, but that doesn't have to be a bad thing. I believe we have the ability to work together to ensure progressive liberals do not get more power in the state. Our differences provide a complement to one another - and that widens our base. We need every single conservative, moderate and independent voter to recognize the dangers of the progressive left.

As we move forward, talk to one another, offer grace to one another, and remember - the opposition is waiting for us to get tangled up with internal issues. Do not give them the satisfaction. Together, we are unbeatable!

Best wishes - Kathleen Kauth, Senator LD31

Kathleen Kauth
