clean_body: Spotlight Feature: Rep. Kathleen Kauth | | | | | | | Good Morning Republicans, As I read our NEGOP constitution, a clear definition is outlined of the actions and administration that is foundational to the success and growth of the party. The constitution has and will always be a framework, the structural strength of a bridge designed to hold all who wish to stand together. Upon this framework, solidly fastened by years of truth and revolution is our Platform planks etched with our values and principles. Some of these planks are severely beaten up from the constant attempts to rip them out because some believe we could LOSE an election if we stand firm on them. If our only goal was to not lose elections this bridge built for truth and justice would have so many gaps, many members would surely fall. Most of all, what bridge is secure or stable without a firm foundation built on Faith? We must purposely choose to see goodness and work towards being the light at all times or our values will bear no fruit. Nebraska State Republican Party Constitution PREAMBLE That our beloved Republic may have the best and most just government and the freest and happiest people of all time, the Republican Party of Nebraska pledges and dedicates itself: To oppose dictators and dictatorships, bureaucrats and bureaucracy; to maintain and continue Constitutional government in our State and Nation; to make sure that our government is one of laws and not of men; and that the laws enacted by the representatives of a free people through the unrestricted exercise of the ballot shall be justly administered and impartially enforced; to perpetuate the spirit of free enterprise; to make the opportunities of succeeding generations greater and better than those of the past; to decrease the burdens imposed by and the expenses incurred in government; to defend at any and all times, in both peace and war, our long established institutions of liberty against attacks from foreign and domestic threats; to the end that our government shall be truly and in fact a “government of the people, by the people, and for the people.” ARTICLE I Name and Objectives Section 1. The name of this organization shall be the Republican Party of Nebraska. Section 2. The objectives of the Party shall be the maintenance of government of, by and for the people according to the Constitution and laws of the United States and the State of Nebraska, and the furtherance of such principles as may from time to time be adopted. ARTICLE II Membership Section 1. The membership of the Party shall be composed of all the registered Republican voters of the State of Nebraska who desire to support the objectives of the Party. The biggest question of all is...who will be willing to work, and work tirelessly, to stand on this bridge of values/principles, this bridge of truth, and at the same time find ways to reach out to others? The work to do this can only come from constant, proactive, measured communication with a desire to have success for all and credit by none. We cannot serve others and at the same time be monument builders or seekers of a legacy. We cannot follow a path that is laid before us if we seek the treasures of this world. We can only believe that through our gifts and talents His will can and will be done. As we turn our focus to political paradigms and searching for solutions, I believe we will not be successful when we politicize each other versus humanize. I believe the more time spent listening and understanding the human components, or qualities in others, the greater chance we can further our principles. I would add a qualifying geographic component to the objective of “the furtherance of such principles” by saying “the furtherance of such principles within our community”. This means that we must focus locally, where we can make the most impact. From within our local communities we can further principles such as Education. Stay tuned for a series of focus and discussion on our principles as well as events and Roundtables to bring a unifying message of what we stand for Here are excerpts from our Platform on Education: Plank: Education The Nebraska Republican Party reaffirms the role of education in the development of effective and responsible citizens. We believe that decisions regarding the education of children properly belong to parents and guardians. We reaffirm our belief that control of all aspects of public education should rest with local school boards, not state or federal agencies. We believe each student should be provided with the opportunity for an excellent academic education. We believe moral training based on principles established by God, under whom we profess to be a nation, should be returned to its proper and traditional place in the public schools. We urge citizens to require fiscal and educational accountability from policy makers, educational institutions, and educational professionals to assure that quality services are being rendered. We support statewide assessments of educational achievement and the administration of the ACT or SAT to all Nebraska 11th-graders. We oppose testing to identify physical, psychological, emotional or developmental disabilities without parental consent. We recognize and commend the dedicated educators and administrators who strive to prepare the students for future decision making that will directly affect the freedom and security of the United States. We encourage patriotism, respect for the American flag and an understanding of our nation’s ideals, which make our form of government the best in the world. We believe the family to be our country’s basic institution and as such should be encouraged to take a larger, not smaller, role in education. We support parental choice in education based on a program of vouchers or tax credits, thus creating better education through the principles of free market competition. These alternatives should include private, parochial and home schools. We believe that all schools and educators, whether public, private, or home school, be recognized for their contributions to the future of our state. We support the right of parents to personally observe all classroom instruction and activities. We strongly support the teaching of the scientific, biologically verifiable X and Y chromosomal definition of male and female at birth, and the use of locker rooms, sports team qualifications, and restrooms based on the same definition. With much blessings, | | –Chairman Underwood | "Donate" | | Spotlight Feature: From Rep Kathleen Kauth | You have heard it said before, but this was an historic legislative session. Not just because we passed significant Income Tax, Property Tax, and Social Security tax legislation, legislation to provide for our public schools and to offer opportunity for poor children to change their educational circumstances, we protected children from experimental, irreversible gender altering procedures and babies after 12 weeks from death. My fellow freshmen Senators and I started our political careers out in what has been described as the most toxic environment on the legislative floor ever. I can't tell you how many times I was told "This has never happened before!" What we know from this experience is that politics is rough, but we are strong enough to take it. The left uses hate, nasty rhetoric, temper tantrums and obstruction of the legislative process to get what they want. This year - they did not succeed. I'm very proud of all we got done, not just in spite of, but because of those leftist tactics. We banded together because our opponents were so blatantly attacking us, our values and our constituents. Although we do not always agree, there is a tremendous amount of respect among the conservative legislators on the floor. Now as we head into the next election cycle we are facing very angry opponents who are calling in lots of money from out of state. We need to work together across the state to identify and support conservative candidates for office. Where there are multiple conservatives running for a single office - I would encourage anyone who doesn't make it through the primary to throw their support behind their fellow conservative who moves through to the general. Conservative leadership is the goal. Our elections have been under attack as well. This summer Seth Paulson, Brian Kruse (Douglas County Election Commissioner) and I met with Wayne Bena from the Secretary of State's office to discuss creating a means to have volunteer observers watching the hand audits of the election. This will give us either more confidence in the accuracy of the machines, or verifiable data of inconsistencies. We will be putting together a pilot program, and implement it for the May 2024 elections. Stay tuned for more information as we develop this program. Our party in Nebraska is in the midst of change, but that doesn't have to be a bad thing. I believe we have the ability to work together to ensure progressive liberals do not get more power in the state. Our differences provide a complement to one another - and that widens our base. We need every single conservative, moderate and independent voter to recognize the dangers of the progressive left. As we move forward, talk to one another, offer grace to one another, and remember - the opposition is waiting for us to get tangled up with internal issues. Do not give them the satisfaction. Together, we are unbeatable! Best wishes - Kathleen Kauth, Senator LD31 Kathleen Kauth Mediation and Business Consulting K.T. Teammates, When I led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan as a Captain in the U.S. Army, we lived by a principle: **Leave no one behind.** The principle that drove our campaign and grounds our administration — leave no one behind — is not a slogan. It’s personal. Right now, too many Marylanders are being left behind. Unable to fill the gas tank or keep up with monthly bills. Feeling unsafe in their own communities, or with their children trapped in chronically underfunded schools. **Together, with Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller and the state legislature, we're changing that.** It's why the 10 bills I introduced and successfully passed in my first 6 months as governor included:
* Restricting where people can carry guns – simply put, no one needs a gun at a preschool, a hospital, or Camden Yards (the NRA disagreed and sued us – I say bring it on)

* Improving banking access to low- and moderate-income communities

* Permanently extending the Earned Income Tax Credit and expanding the Child Tax Credit to reduce childhood poverty

* Raising the minimum wage to $15/hour in January 2024

**This is what leave no one behind looks like.** Folks, I believe Maryland is the best state in America to live and raise a family, but to fulfill our potential, we must make sure all Marylanders have that opportunity at success. I'm going to keep fighting every day to make that happen. **[And if you're committed to being in the fight too, I hope you'll join me by making a donation.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68466759/423140248/-2109446099?refcode=EM_FL_WES_20230822_fr_leave_cand_mf_90da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTAzZjFlNC1mMzQwLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nEaVEnLBjNfIuYfGVOd9Y6lPujHbxjCyggz6Bo2clB8=)** | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

NUHW Is The Latest Major Healthcare Workers’ Union To Throw Support Behind Min For CA-47 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ff404b968957/release-healthcare-workers-endorse-state-senator-dave-min-15660712?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For Immediate Release:** August 22, 2023
**Contact:[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)**
**Healthcare Workers Endorse State Senator Dave Min** _NUHW Is The Latest Major Healthcare Workers’ Union To Throw Support Behind Min For CA-47_ **IRVINE, CA** — Today, the National Union of Healthcare Workers announced their endorsement of Dave Min for US Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District. NUHW joins statewide labor organizations–the Service Employees International Union and the California Federation of Teachers–as well as an impressive cohort of locals, including UFCW 324, Teamsters Joint Council 42, IBEW locals 47 and 441, and IUPAT District Council 36, in throwing support behind California State Senator Dave Min. Sen. Min is quickly emerging as organized labor’s choice for CA-47, and is the only candidate in the race to receive the early endorsement of a local or national union. Dave Min has a record of advocating on behalf of healthcare and other service workers, and is quickly emerging as the candidate of choice for Orange County’s working families in the healthcare industry.
**“Dave Min is the only candidate running for Congress in CA-47 who has spent their career fighting on behalf of working families,”** said NUHW President Sal Rosselli. **“As state senator, he delivered on many of our biggest priorities — advancing affordable health care, improving mental health care access, and bringing infrastructure resources to Orange County so that working people can better afford to live near their jobs. In Washington, he will be our trusted partner in the fight to protect a woman's right to choose, defend the rights of working Americans and expand access to health care including mental health care. Importantly— we believe Dave Min is uniquely poised to keep this very competitive district Blue. We are proud to endorse Dave Min for Congress.”**
Founded in 2009 by rank-and-file healthcare employees, NUHW now represents more than 16,000 members, including medical technicians and technologists, clerical workers, psychologists, pharmacists, housekeepers, dietary workers, nurses, nursing assistants, drug rehabilitation counselors, mental health clinicians, engineers, and a number of other hospital and home healthcare workers across Orange County and California. Dave Min has been an advocate for working families throughout his tenure as the State Senator for California’s District 37, and will continue that close partnership with organized labor in Washington, DC.

Sen. Min is organized labor’s choice for CA-47, and is the only candidate in the race to receive the early endorsement of a local or national union. After impressive fundraising hauls in the first and second quarter of this year, Dave Min continues to set the pace for Katie Porter’s open Congressional seat by adding to his political coalition throughout the summer. Min has consolidated support from local, state, and national endorsers. Min entered the race with support from current CA-47 Representative, Katie Porter. In recent months, Min has announced the endorsements of California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis, Attorney General Rob Bonta, State Treasurer Fiona Ma, Insurance Commissioner Ricard Lara, Superintendent of Public Schools Tony Thurmond, the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus’s political leadership ASPIRE PAC, more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators. A full endorsement list is available[ here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=07c7693e89&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._ ### _Dave Min is endorsed by incumbent Congresswoman Katie Porter, as well as SEIU, CFT, LAPPL, UFCW 324, Teamsters Joint Council 42, IBEW locals 47 and 441, and IUPAT District Council 36, AAPI Victory Fund, Asian American Action Fund, Asian American Forward, Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders Rising and Empowering (ASPIRE) PAC, and Democrats Serve. Min is endorsed by Congressmember Judy Chu, CA-28, Congressmember Andy Kim, NJ-03, Congressmember Grace Meng, NY-06, Congressmember Kevin Mullin, CA-15, Congressmember Scott Peters, CA-50, Congressmember Katie Porter, CA-47, Congressmember Mark Takano, CA-41. Min is also endorsed by more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators._

It is clear that this is nothing but a politically motivated attempt to tarnish the legacy of a man who fought tirelessly for the American people and brought about unprecedented economic prosperity and security. It’s time to see through the smoke and mirrors of this indictment. It is a blatant attempt to undermine the core principles that have made our great nation what it is today – freedom, opportunity, and limited government. We cannot and will not allow this blatant misuse of the legal system to go unchecked. President Trump stood up against the establishment, working tirelessly to secure our borders, bolster our military, and put America First in every decision he made. He empowered businesses to thrive, created millions of jobs, and championed policies that lifted everyday Americans out of the struggles they faced for far too long. The timing of this indictment is no coincidence. As conservatives, we have always known that our fight is not just against opposing ideologies, but against the tactics of division and distraction that seek to weaken our resolve. | The radical left wants to dismantle the progress we achieved under President Trump and are resorting to desperate measures, attempting to distract us from the true issues at hand. Let me be clear: I stand unwaveringly with President Trump. I stand with the values that bind us as conservatives, as Texans, and as proud Americans. We cannot allow these unjust attacks to deter us from our mission of safeguarding individual liberties, defending our constitutional rights, and ensuring a prosperous future for generations to come. body:

| | | | | Peter, A month or two ago I wrote to you with a big announcement: my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is running for Congress in New York’s 19th District – one of the most competitive races in the country. Now I’m back with an even bigger announcement: Josh is running for Congress in one of the most competitive races in the country... AND his wife just had a baby! [While Josh is catching sleep in 30-minute increments and cleaning up spit-up, I’m pitching in to make sure his fundraising doesn’t look like a dirty diaper. So I have to ask, will you split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T13029940-2c7b-4f7d-9f1f-d15344e84d2b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| You know who’s probably getting a full night's sleep? Josh’s opponent, Marc Molinaro. In fact, he’s probably dreaming about taking away someone’s rights, rolling back gun safety legislation or blocking progress on clean energy – he’s only been in Congress a couple of months and he’s already done all that and more! We need someone like Josh in Congress – he’s the real deal. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1a067274-21ae-44f3-b439-a024fa9144b4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
(The really tall guy is Josh.) After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh worked on a landmark civil rights lawsuit to help kids from low-income families get access to healthcare. When I was in the Senate, Josh and I passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. And since then, Josh has fought in the Supreme Court to block the Trump Administration’s Muslim Ban and plans to deport Dreamers. Even before he was a dad, Josh was always looking out for the little guy. [So what do you say, Peter? Will you split $15 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Blue Amp Action and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T963d8f6c-b42f-4fa0-8bcd-43cd71bf1223/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks, Al

body:
This race will be one of the most competitive Senate races
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-1?refcode=em20230822-1&refcode2=478_552475_8avN_i&akid=478%2E552475%2E8avN_i)
Peter,
**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I'm an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I'm announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida's next U.S. Senator.**
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I'm prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy -- and even more, I'm prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we're up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete -- and win -- is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.[Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Bob Casey's right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230822-1&refcode2=478_552475_8avN_i&akid=478%2E552475%2E8avN_i)
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-1?refcode=em20230822-1&refcode2=478_552475_8avN_i&akid=478%2E552475%2E8avN_i)**
**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren't easy. But thanks to my mother's relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
**My story -- coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress -- is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he's proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He's pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
**That's why I'm running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot -- which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter, _we can take him down._**
**So please, I'm personally asking:[Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Bob Casey today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230822-1&refcode2=478_552475_8avN_i&akid=478%2E552475%2E8avN_i)
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-1?refcode=em20230822-1&refcode2=478_552475_8avN_i&akid=478%2E552475%2E8avN_i)**
Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.
With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

name: Sean Barry via ActionNetwork.org
subject: We need leadership in Houston
body:
| | | Friend, When we consider the leaders and representatives in our country, we hope that they are thinking about our community’s best interests. Unfortunately, this is not always the case. Texas’ 29th Congressional District representative, Sylvia Garcia, is running for re-election. In the wake of everything our country has gone through over the last few years, we need representatives who will:
* Take action
* Introduce effective legislation
* Stand up for their constituents.

Sylvia Garcia, although holding office since 2016, has done none of this. Her passivity and negligence have had dire effects on our district. I feel the growing anger in our communities, and I share your frustrations. The people of Houston need leadership - and I’m ready to offer that. That’s why I have chosen to run for Congress here in TX-29. My campaign is based on the fundamental principles of advocacy, accountability, and direct aid to the communities we serve. I am not going to rely on legislation alone.**I will bring leadership and organization to mobilize the most active citizens to pressure officials and companies to listen to our needs.** If you would like to learn more about how my campaign will help the people of Texas, and our country regardless of electoral success, [please check out my website](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOH8vS-H2wVKd-2YocowzUKsqJ2Uw2Dw7Hu4rQilhmmHhPjBa14JlvtykRTmyNFCOsJvrG7UVdn2EDz1h5FwP4UNq4JkYCuD44-72-9qlQVBLu4Uw-LHSPMfMfrH2rSXB_o-JfWb3tpbU9ORnwaMQOdi71rrE_1cbaHxluc4YekGmXUXd5mgoMiukwm0QD2xgtzr_HZHJSIoFWfEpFqZVFsYG1idh4byUSpfoB8th2cfkzNUufqCHTT7xPTbGB8org/3yy/8rhCZPaPQ6mYjUyew9LIJQ/h0/VZF__znf2rz94mceBodgVR72X5K6b9AZ54-exzNpvWY) or follow me on [Twitter](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhvKvF23nMWYkeCgP0UfX7pCEscdcAj-jlOwn6JC5vfV55SDJkhwGUHC1yFFE3pn5AjX_-4IVLaLzfsexvLHmK5Pz216YyUSc-BXkrvxDgDa7TE5lAk6vQTS-p7PoB57rH-ZXmi7mqq-SO-acCKhSIyoF_UHGYwToe357tGggKNH0oQ-jXEHHuty5KfCzsNN1_DHc1f9BJHFAb-T55GXh0pfma662mu8Z0iIJdSfQmW4I0bQQcPybei4DbIa8YJ6rYwYvCyA5S0jJhobfErrfDkQ/3yy/8rhCZPaPQ6mYjUyew9LIJQ/h1/rEFJTLnW7-kGkoTaB7PPNdIwxCwqjrnq3xD7qzNccIY)! We deserve leaders who consider our best interests. I’m ready to win this battle and make it to Washington to ensure that our communities are taken care of. Thank you for your time, Sean Barry Candidate for Congress (TX-29)

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to _destroy_ the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, friend,_we can take him down._**

body:
We can’t take anything for granted, Peter.
#
Peter,

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230822-1?amount=5refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)
Derek,
**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and _win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.[Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Katie Porter’s campaign right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230822-1?amount=5refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230822-1?refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)
**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. **But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to _destroy_ the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Derek,_we can take him down._**
**So please, I’m personally asking:[Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Katie Porter’s campaign today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230822-1?amount=5refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230822-1?refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)
Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.
With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAK22_1_DMP_20230822_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=28605_3422442_2_mK0d&akid=28605%2E3422442%2E2_mK0d)**

Apologies for being so direct, but we need to pick up the pace.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=640%2E135344%2Ecy-iX2)

Friend -- we're asking you to make a $5 donation today to support Elissa Slotkin’s campaign for Senate in Michigan.
Sometimes people ask us why we ask for the equivalent of a cup of fancy coffee. They question whether small donations actually matter.
They do. It takes a village to get this done, and it’s so important that we maintain a steady pace of support. All signs point to a Republican opponent – or two – announcing in the coming days or weeks, and with their announcement will come a flood of support from National Republican groups who know that their path to control the Senate runs right through Michigan.
With public polling showing our race in a dead heat, we have to be prepared to match our Republican opponent dollar-for-dollar so we can defend this open seat and protect our slim Democratic Senate majority.
We know that $5 may not sound like a lot on its own, but trust us, it all adds up when there are hundreds of people chipping in and showing their support. It’s how we’ve won our past campaigns and it’s how we plan to keep up the momentum to win this race too.

Dear Friend,
---
God is faithful. Sometimes it's easier to say than it is to believe, and other times His faithfulness is so obvious, you can't help but shout. This is one of those times where shouting is in order!

When we recorded our brand new song, _Faithfulness of God_ , we had NO IDEA the testimony God was working behind the scenes in Spokane, WA. We had been fervently praying for God to move in the life of the young man who broke into my car and stole my guitar, and this weekend, that man accepted Jesus into his heart and was baptized! God. Is. Faithful!!! _🎶 I prayed. He answered,
In ways I can't fathom.
Always, I will live to testify.
I have seen it for myself,
The faithfulness of God.
I have lived enough to tell,
He's never failed me once.
From beginning to end,
He’s been good no matter.
My story is the faithfulness of God!__🎶_ _**WATCH FAITHFULNESS OF GOD LIVE**_

As we approach the 2024 election season, it is remains imperative that we support the men and women who have served our country in uniform that are now serving our country in a different way - in Congress.
These veterans have continued their commitment to public service by representing their communities with integrity and fighting for the livelihoods of their constituents in every corner of our nation.
Mikie Sherrill [https://www.mikiesherrill.com/] has served the 11th District since 2019 and continues to champion issues of national security, defense, and veterans’ affairs.
Pat Ryan [https://www.patryanforcongress.com/] has served New York's 18th District since earlier this year, spending his first term in Congress fighting for his constituents' foundational freedoms and funding public safety initiatives.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kpwcca2p3EA [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kpwcca2p3EA]
And Jeff Jackson [https://www.jeffjacksonnc.com/] , a freshman from North Carolina, has used his social media presence to inform North Carolina’s 14th District, as well as the entire country, of the progress he has made expanding Medicaid, increasing school funding, and standing up for women’s reproductive rights.
In 2024 we have the opportunity to extend this progress.
By donating to veterans currently in office, [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/takingthehill] you can play a critical role in ensuring that veterans’ voices continue to be heard.
If reelected, these veteran candidates can carry on demonstrating their leadership, commitment to service, and their strong understanding of the issues our nation faces.
We are working hard to ensure they can continue this work. We hope you will join us, too.
You can donate to the cause here:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/takingthehill [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/takingthehill]
Yours in the fight,
Patrick J. Murphy

| Peter, **Parental rights in New Jersey are UNDER SIEGE.** A New Jersey judge ruled on Friday that **three school districts are violating the law if they inform parents that their child wants to change their gender identity.** **A little boy as young as FIVE years old could decide to use the girls bathroom and be called Jenny instead of Johnny AND PARENTS WILL BE LIED TO ABOUT THE SITUATION.** This is perhaps the most egregious assault on moms and dads in our state’s history. The ruling comes after these districts smartly put policies in place to keep parents informed about kids who were either suffering from mental disorder, gender dysphoria, or were just acting out. Now these kids - who are too young to decide on what to eat or when to go to bed - can start on the paths that can lead to mutilation surgery, drugs, suicide or a lifetime of mental depression and anxiety. _**Our rights as parents are being stripped away by radicals like Phil Murphy and the morally bankrupt judges who back up insane policies like this.**_ These districts, Marlboro, Manalapan-Englishtown, and Middletown, had implemented policies in the spring to notify parents when their child started on this road of changing their gender identity, including changes in pronouns, name, bathroom preferences, and participation in sports teams. **However, the overreaching hand of the government is coming down hard, trying to keep parents in the dark. The government is actively working to separate parents from their own children.** Governor Phil Murphy and NJ Attorney General Matthew Platkin are trying to sell the false narrative that informing parents harms a so-called ‘transgender’ student’s rights...at FIVE years old! **But isn't it harmful to keep parents out of the loop regarding their children's well-being?**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

and a balanced budget amendment.

manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a

governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital
currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a
constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and
entities,

Lowering prescription drug costs,

Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

Creating a universal school choice program,

Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme
Court,

his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of
nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the

1.5 million votes.

points.

overall.

cower in the calm docks of despotism."

opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden

the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered
the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's
history.

Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering
transparency

The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border
crisis

No

body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=1013%2E35263%2EdNdCXu ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

It’s Tammy here. I wanted to make sure you heard that my friend Debbie
Mucarsel-Powell is running for the U.S. Senate. Her message is below:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=1013%2E35263%2EdNdCXu ]Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Peter,

My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former
Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott
and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch
him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect
our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m
prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024,
and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64
million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The
only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots
Democrats like you.

I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of
launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach
it. [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=1013%2E35263%2EdNdCXu ]Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Tammy
Baldwin right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=1013%2E35263%2EdNdCXu ]DONATE NOW

When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to
find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom
worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn
English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends
meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a
brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college,
become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write
the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of
Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time
in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my
family a shot at a better life.

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars,
yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class.
He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to
end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.

That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick
will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means
that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you,
Peter, we can take him down.

So please, I’m personally asking: [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=1013%2E35263%2EdNdCXu ]Will you become one of my very first
grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Tammy
Baldwin today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick
Scott and defending our Senate majority.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Tammy Baldwin will go through
immediately:

body:
What would you like your state leaders to focus on?

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68481010/423189905/-456841951?refcode=BEB_EM_FR_230822Tshirts_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzNDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzMwZDRjNWItMGI0MS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j3mUY6tKHggIr0W1G8yIclsG6RJ1iMT_Vn7vLezz9uc=) Peter, when you think of what you’d like your state leaders to focus on, do you think of how your taxes are spent or t-shirts being sold at Target?

When tens of millions of taxpayer dollars intended to help low-income families were given away to politicians’ celebrity pals, AG Fitch didn’t investigate. She didn’t prosecute. _She didn’t pursue a single consequence for those responsible._

She did, however, join other state attorneys general in attacking Target for selling Pride merchandise.

Peter, we’re working hard every day to elect Greta Kemp Martin as Mississippi’s next Attorney General because she’s tired of seeing our hard-earned tax dollars go to waste with zero accountability.

As our AG, Greta won’t hesitate to investigate violations of the law and prosecute the people at fault. She’ll enhance whistleblower protections so that people who know the law is being broken aren’t afraid to come forward. And she’ll use our state’s resources to improve the lives of our families, not to attack national corporations for Pride representation.

name: Jane Kwon
subject: OLCV's 2023 Photo Contest: 9 days to go!
body:
| | | Dear Peter, There’s just nine days to go until it’s August 31st and OLCV stops accepting submissions for our Photo Contest. Right now, we have over 200 entries! Thank you to everyone who sent in their photos. Here are a few we got recently that I hope you'll enjoy: Brianna Quinn Lewis submitted a haunting photo of Ashland that she took "when the fires were really bad and the smoke was intense." Carlos G captured this beautiful double rainbow while driving on the South 5 between Salem and Albany, adding "just nature showing off now!" Stephen Ducat in Joseph, OR sent in this photo, writing "Here, my canine collaborator, Riley, stops to vogue on a log bench on our jaunt through Iwetemlykin State Park. Chief Joseph Mountain still retains its spring snow in the background." And Will Hobbs sent in this glorious picture of the Three Sisters. If you haven’t entered our photo contest yet, **you have nine days to send up to three photos of Oregon to respond@olcv.org with the subject “Photo Contest”**. In the body of the email, please include your name, where you took the photo, and a couple sentences about why the photos you’re sending are meaningful to you. Unlike previous years, we do not have categories for OLCV's 2023 Photo Contest, so show your love for our state however you want! You can send in photos of your friends and family enjoying the outdoors, your surroundings and community during extreme weather events, or nature nearby. I can't wait to see them! Thank you,
Jane Kwon
Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

body:
NUHW Is The Latest Major Healthcare Workers’ Union To Throw Support Behind Min For CA-47 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4143e1a96a44/release-healthcare-workers-endorse-state-senator-dave-min-15660736?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For Immediate Release:** August 22, 2023
**Contact:[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)**
**Healthcare Workers Endorse State Senator Dave Min** _NUHW Is The Latest Major Healthcare Workers’ Union To Throw Support Behind Min For CA-47_ **IRVINE, CA** — Today, the National Union of Healthcare Workers announced their endorsement of Dave Min for US Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District. NUHW joins statewide labor organizations–the Service Employees International Union and the California Federation of Teachers–as well as an impressive cohort of locals, including UFCW 324, Teamsters Joint Council 42, IBEW locals 47 and 441, and IUPAT District Council 36, in throwing support behind California State Senator Dave Min. Sen. Min is quickly emerging as organized labor’s choice for CA-47, and is the only candidate in the race to receive the early endorsement of a local or national union. Dave Min has a record of advocating on behalf of healthcare and other service workers, and is quickly emerging as the candidate of choice for Orange County’s working families in the healthcare industry.
**“Dave Min is the only candidate running for Congress in CA-47 who has spent their career fighting on behalf of working families,”** said NUHW President Sal Rosselli. **“As state senator, he delivered on many of our biggest priorities — advancing affordable health care, improving mental health care access, and bringing infrastructure resources to Orange County so that working people can better afford to live near their jobs. In Washington, he will be our trusted partner in the fight to protect a woman's right to choose, defend the rights of working Americans and expand access to health care including mental health care. Importantly— we believe Dave Min is uniquely poised to keep this very competitive district Blue. We are proud to endorse Dave Min for Congress.”**
Founded in 2009 by rank-and-file healthcare employees, NUHW now represents more than 16,000 members, including medical technicians and technologists, clerical workers, psychologists, pharmacists, housekeepers, dietary workers, nurses, nursing assistants, drug rehabilitation counselors, mental health clinicians, engineers, and a number of other hospital and home healthcare workers across Orange County and California. Dave Min has been an advocate for working families throughout his tenure as the State Senator for California’s District 37, and will continue that close partnership with organized labor in Washington, DC.

Sen. Min is organized labor’s choice for CA-47, and is the only candidate in the race to receive the early endorsement of a local or national union. After impressive fundraising hauls in the first and second quarter of this year, Dave Min continues to set the pace for Katie Porter’s open Congressional seat by adding to his political coalition throughout the summer. Min has consolidated support from local, state, and national endorsers. Min entered the race with support from current CA-47 Representative, Katie Porter. In recent months, Min has announced the endorsements of California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis, Attorney General Rob Bonta, State Treasurer Fiona Ma, Insurance Commissioner Ricard Lara, Superintendent of Public Schools Tony Thurmond, the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus’s political leadership ASPIRE PAC, more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators. A full endorsement list is available[ here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=30ee14ec53&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._ ### _Dave Min is endorsed by incumbent Congresswoman Katie Porter, as well as SEIU, CFT, LAPPL, UFCW 324, Teamsters Joint Council 42, IBEW locals 47 and 441, and IUPAT District Council 36, AAPI Victory Fund, Asian American Action Fund, Asian American Forward, Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders Rising and Empowering (ASPIRE) PAC, and Democrats Serve. Min is endorsed by Congressmember Judy Chu, CA-28, Congressmember Andy Kim, NJ-03, Congressmember Grace Meng, NY-06, Congressmember Kevin Mullin, CA-15, Congressmember Scott Peters, CA-50, Congressmember Katie Porter, CA-47, Congressmember Mark Takano, CA-41. Min is also endorsed by more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators._

We live in a special community. Let's keep it that way. |

| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=ea15bdc8d2&e=1090c5c412)

| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Last week, at the Blue Valley Farm Show in Bangor, I was talking with my new friends Joe and Francine, who moved to the Slate Belt from North Jersey. I asked them why they came to the Lehigh Valley and Francine told the most inspiring story.

She said her family was camping near Mt. Bethel and stopped by a roadside stand to buy some vegetables, but there was nobody there to take the money. Instead, she just found a Tupperware container with a hole in the lid to put the cash.

She had never seen anything like that before and thought something was wrong or it was a trick. She put her money in the container and left with the tomatoes but worried all week about the experience.

The following weekend they went camping again, and this time the farmer was at the stand. He explained that no, nothing was wrong, that he’s been using the honor system for years. He said the only problem he ever has is that sometimes people forget to put the rock back on the container and the lid blows off.

Francine was amazed. She told her husband that she wanted to live in a place where people can sell vegetables like that, where she could prove to her kids that there are still honest people left in the world. So, they packed up and moved to Bangor.

Thank you, Joe and Francine, for sharing that story, and welcome to the Lehigh Valley. I hope you and your family can always feel that way about your new home, and I trust that you are setting a great example for your children. God Bless!

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 35 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106667/images/unnamed%20%285%29.png]
The foundation of any strong democracy relies on free, fair, and accessible elections. The unsung heroes who ensure this process runs smoothly are our dedicated poll workers and officials.
Unfortunately, these heroes are now facing unprecedented threats that jeopardize both their safety and the integrity of our elections. Protect our election workers by adding your name now! Peter,
Election workers have become the target of online and offline threats that deter them from carrying out their vital duties. subject: Tomorrow night, Republican's extremist ideas will be on full display
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
Friend,
We’ll get straight to the point.
**Right now, the Republican presidential candidates are gearing up for their first debate tomorrow night in Milwaukee, WI.**
There is one thing we already know for certain: Republicans are going to use this debate to appeal to the most extreme parts of their party and say anything they can to get a headline or soundbite. Whether it be attacking the trans community or abortion rights, nothing is off limits when they are preaching their divisive agenda.
These extremists are going to continue to spread hatred and fear, but we must fight back to protect Americans and their freedoms. And it starts with us standing up for Wisconsin voters today.
It is no coincidence that they are having their debate and convention in Milwaukee. These voters are essential to the White House, but Wisconsinites know these candidates won’t have their back.
So we need to show up strong for Wisconsin voters. Because they deserve to be heard and have leaders that understand their struggles — ones that will serve their best interests — not extremists that descend on their state and spread hatred and fear.
We value the voices of Wisconsinites, so we must fight to amplify their voices so they are heard loud and clear on Election Day.
[**So can you please split a $5 contribution between Power to the Polls Wisconsin and The Long Run today so we can mobilize and support voters in Wisconsin?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-power2thepolls-split.vXbZtT&refcode=em230822-1-t2&t=1&akid=4758%2E196590%2E8uwxo7)
Tomorrow night, Republicans will put their extremist views on full display. It’s going to make the stakes of 2024 even more clear and we must do everything we can to stop the GOP from buying this election.
\- The team at the Long Run

_**SPEAK OUT and BE HEARD**_ _**Please see two testimonies by**_ _**Dominic Rapini and Chris Coyle of 2WINCT**_
_Still time to submit testimony and speak out against the Ban on Gas Powered Gars_
_Written comments on the proposal can still be provided. Comments should be submitted no later than 5 pm on August 23, 2023, via the eRegulations System (PR 2023-023) or by electronic mail to the Mobile Sources Group at**deep.mobilesources@ct.gov**_
|
---
**Net zero carbon should not mean a net loss for Connecticut****By Dominic Rapini**
My name is Dominic Rapini, Chairman of 2WINCT an organization founded on the principles of freedom and liberty as put forward by the US Constitution. My testimony today is in opposition to proposed amendments to the Air Quality Regulations as proposed in section 4-168(a) of Connecticut Statutes and the adoption of section 22a-174G as well as section 177 of the federal Clean Air Act.
**Forcing a ban on gas-powered vehicles is a bad policy, based on based bad assumptions, based on bad economics, based on bad timing**
Our US Constitution makes clear that other than the rights enumerated in the Constitution, all other Rights Retained By the People: Include the freedom and the right of Americans to make their own economic decisions. In all matters of economics, we the people, defer to the free market which brought the United States, and the world, boundless prosperity, wealth, and mankind’s greatest advancements in science and medicine. In constitutional terms, the proposed ban on gas-powered transportation is not only a violation of our Constitutional rights but of the very free market principles that are the bedrock of our well-being as a people and a nation. Government interference and coercion in the cloak of a noble cause, however, flawed the logic behind the decision, is never permissible.
**Listen when the Free Market Speaks and you will know the difference between a bad idea and a good policy**
Just in the past Summer CEOs from Ford (LINK) and Toyota (LINK)discussed how the Electric Vehicle (EV) infrastructure and recharging times are woefully inadequate and how they are tapping the brakes on EV production respectfully. Suncor announced its plan to divest investments in wind and solar while focusing on oil production and renewable energy like Hydrogen. Famous car makers like Porsche and Ferrari have other innovations to move to carbon neutral but not EVs. What expertise or right does the government, let alone unelected regulators have to dictate what will happen?
**Follow the money or lack of it**
While surveys show 50% of consumers plan on buying an EV few consumers believe in an EV future like the State of CT is proposing. Current inventories of EVs are stacking up with over 100 days of supply in an industry where 50 days of supply is the norm. Tesla leads the market share but all other manufacturers are far in the rear review mirror. Why are EV sales not stronger? Perhaps because the ‘carbonless’ solution can only be afforded by the society elite. In Connecticut, the median income is $40,000 yr while the average EV costs $53K to $100K. How do we expect the working class to get to work or go shopping with their kids, on e-bikes? Americans, thanks to cumulative inflation, are now paying $700 more a month for the same goods they purchased in 2021. The Connecticut working class is not thinking EV when they can barely put food on the table. No government handout changes that outlook.
**Follow the Science, Do the Math**
Despite the incredible hype around EVs the Connecticut elite have only purchased and registered 25,000 electric cars since 2010 and they are supported by 593 charging stations(1,638 ports) statewide, about one station for every 42 EVs in service, far below the required 10 cars per charger! In addition, there are multiple standards of charging port connectors in service which means all charging ports may not be compatible with your EV!! There are over 2.9M registered cars in Connecticut. Fast forward to a mandate whereby 2040 these vehicles are all or mostly transitioned to EV. It would require 290,000 charging ports/stations to support the vehicles and that is before we calculate the upgrade of a carbon-dependent, unstable electric grid with power lines, and a redesigned power infrastructure, an incalculable and devastating burden on Connecticut.
The proposed conversion to 100% EV by 2034, at the exclusion of gas-powered cars, will result in the conversion of the 1.1M new cars (current run-rate) purchased annually in Connecticut from gas to Electric. With an incremental price tag of $13K or more per car, Connecticut consumer car expenses will increase by 1.4 billion dollars. That assumes no price increase up, to and following, the proposed mandate!! This is a high price to pay for an automobile that has a range of 150 miles and requires 6 hours to fully charge.
_Connecticut is not ready for the expense and the infrastructure requirements for 100% EV_
**All solutions work best with a carrot and not a stick**
While the theme of this testimony has revolved around the constitutional infringement of the proposed amendments; the lack of preparation or foresight into the infrastructure requirements; the financial impact on working-class families and many other unresolved issues around the near future of EVs, the core objection is the mandate of these programs by unelected bureaucrats.
In the free market great ideas, and positive programs, all happen naturally and without government coercion. I am not fundamentally in opposition to EVs because I fundamentally believe in choice. Choice by the individual and by the market. I would recommend we replace the idea of forcing electronic vehicles with programs that make EVs possible. Tax credits, private investment, and a government role centered on facilitation in a manner that allows the taxpayers of Connecticut to make an informed choice. A choice of their timing and based on their means and preference. We do that and we have a win, win - for we the people, and the environment.
**Reference** The 2030 National Charging Network ([LINK](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=23be1618b5&e=8763c56857))

* https://www.power-grid.com/energy-efficiency/little-known-but-efficient-a-different-way-to-heat-and-cool-your-house/
*

_Dominic Rapini_

**My Car - by Chris Coyle**
The Mystery and Wonder of The Car and Our Individual FreedomsRoll down the windows, stomp the accelerator, and hit the open road. The wind in our hair, and the power rumbling under the hood, powerful emotions are evoked by our cars, especially the feeling of individual freedom and expression. There is perhaps no property or possession that equates more closely with freedom than our cars do.From paint jobs, tires and hub caps to decals, hood ornaments and personal items hanging from the rear-view mirror, cars are a core element of the American experience, serving as part of our national identity and personal individuality. According to lyrics.com there are 206,191 song lyrics and 50 albums that include the word car. From bands named the Cars, and famous songs like the Beatles “Drive my Car”, and Prince’s “Little Red Corvette” to the classic Beach Boy’s song “I get around”, cars are a part of our culture and identities.
What makes cars special in the United States is the concept of “My” car. The use of “My” is a statement of personal identity and acknowledgement of your private property and it’s use for your own desires. Under our nation’s founding, the recognition of natural rights belonging to everyone serves as the foundation of “My”. It is one of our most important founding values and constitutional principles.Our nation’s founders certainly do not know what a car was, but they thought deeply about the centuries of monarchs and despots that decided what, if anything you could own, where and when you could possess it and how much and for how long. Your self-initiative, creativity and industry did not matter. Often your societal class by birth determined what was “yours”.
By contrast, car clubs and groups of all kinds are gatherings of individuals who share a common passion from vintage cars to high performance models. The parading, rallying, racing and other car related activities are based on a common passion for the make and model of their cars. However, these groups don’t give you your identity with your car or the right to it; it remains “Your” car.
Although the operation of cars on public roads is a privilege that includes requirements and restrictions, the government doesn’t give you the right to your car. It is your property to determine what you do with it. Unlike other counties where the right of property ownership is given by the government, our rights emanate from our nation’s founding which was built upon individual or natural rights. Called “unalienable rights” in our Declaration of Independence the concept of “mine” and “yours”, and other rights became the basis of our nation’s founding.
Some may use their cars for making money while others may restore and trade cars for profit. Whether used for commerce or pleasure, the ownership concept of “My” prevails. If a person becomes talented at buying and selling cars or building cars and becomes wealthy as a result of his industriousness, we have no right to his profits just as he has no right in “Your” car.
But when does your car stop becoming yours? If you are mandated to use a different form of energy such as electric batteries or are forced to pay more for increasingly expensive gasoline because unelected government officials have declared it so, has your right to your car been diminished if not extinguished? And what about the freedom of car manufacturers to build the cars customers want? Will they be forced to risk billions to retool their assembly lines and search for increasingly scarce raw materials for batteries?
The concept of a far more limited and lower powered selection of car models may be hard for us to envision. Can anyone really imagine a Yugo inspiring the excitement of a Corvette? For younger readers, the Yugo was manufactured in Communist Yugoslavian in the 1980s and has been called the “Worst Car in History”. Even so, cars are so important that there are Yugo car collectors and clubs!The concept of “My” car may be a fading memory, as it increasingly becomes less and less “Your” car. What does the erosion of the freedom associated with our cars portend to other areas of our life? Will car songs become a historical relic like the freedoms we once attached to them? Wonder what the next genre of car songs will be? Submitted Chris Coyle

body:
Will you join the fight for a better future?
Derek, I'm running to be Florida's next U.S. Senator — and I hope you'll give me a moment to share why.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230822-1?refcode=em20230822-1-8517&refcode2=8517_434096_zA2_9M&akid=8517%2E434096%2EzA2_9M)
_My husband and three children._
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.
We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.
My mother's hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**
**_And that's why I'm running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we've got to fight for it._**
Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He's targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It's no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.
With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America -- but not without all hands on deck.
**[So please, will you join the fight for a better future by splitting a donation of $5 between John Fetterman and my campaign? If we win in Florida, Democrats are virtually guaranteed to defend our Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230822-1?refcode=em20230822-1-8517&refcode2=8517_434096_zA2_9M&akid=8517%2E434096%2EzA2_9M)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230822-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230822-8517&refcode2=8517_434096_zA2_9M&akid=8517%2E434096%2EzA2_9M)**
Thank you for joining me in this fight. I'm so grateful to have you by my side.
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230822-8517-footer&t=1&refcode2=8517_434096_zA2_9M&akid=8517%2E434096%2EzA2_9M)**

Fellow Conservative,

It’s Speaker Newt Gingrich with a couple of thoughts for you today.

I recently met with some of my friends over lunch to talk shop, and during this lunch you can probably guess what we talked about: _**politics.**_

We discussed how we’re going to hold onto the House, while flipping the Senate in November 2024. _**I think it’s safe to say that everyone at the table agrees that though we certainly have our work cut out for us**_ , we’re in a good position to successfully execute our goals.

A couple of things came up that I want to talk to you about today, one in particular: **our chances of flipping the long-held Democrat Senate seat in Montana.**

**[I took the liberty of recording a video for you that I hope you’ll take a moment to watch right now.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7d3560cb7ca648aca640e53a6151605a&_e=2qXkxFO7BZRguhxHsojFpJoAMKp-l7PL5gmkCHD81tI0qiH9WhoLlZnnW0Xxu1WGUutxp0dxsEUrgKvIHky55TQFtbHz_7I8K0uLlX_69BUp5ia25x_CuUn_cu4wAcAMdwYem4xqYaSHzApIOcMqKLB2-fJKVy0doYdTOYli-FhVY-0l_APmXO4aQyPuYYhxGMOqUSPAeFFJOfPMwDVDeWaa_LrddIBjBkdX6BJKzVT3LNzdefsMLy1_hVQYbfmbrpoWjNDCYhombzPCmbhezGD7RAq8aiSkbmSZBhu2zoIEaU3K8Kvw5QuZruVHxNSaq83jFPGtZVndxILlV8gLj6GOPhrnP1vSmBlrWbobu6PRlNgG2efAUmHAM_wa7AZoVeDJtDY3fIBCIja5wSVhRg%3D%3D)

| Friends, You were tricked. The RNC told us they would be fair in their qualification for the August debate happening tomorrow night. **They lied.** And to prove their lies, we’re going to take them on in court. [**But we need your help once more. Please contribute any amount you can TODAY so that we can mount our legal defense against the RNC, and move towards qualifying for the debate in September.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=eaf1057572&e=0be619cbaa) You see, at the 11th hour, the RNC said we did not meet the criteria to be on the debate stage. The truth is our qualification packaged included proof of:
* EXCEEDING the RNC’s requirement of at least 40,000 individual donors.
* EXCEEDING the RNC’s requirement of 200 donors in 20 states (Elder nearly doubled that, with 200 donors in at least 37 states).
* MEETING the RNC’s polling requirement of at least 1% in select polls and providing the detailed cross tabs of such polls.
* SIGNING the “Beat Biden” loyalty pledge to support the ultimate GOP nominee.
* AGREEING to allow the RNC to view our WinRed fundraising totals, which exceed their requirements; and,
* Other pertinent required information to participate in the debate.

Only after receiving our completed qualification package, did the RNC inform us that they were not accepting the Rasmussen Polls as qualifying toward the debate. The reason, as stated by the RNC, is that Rasmussen Polls have ties to former President Donald Trump — an individual who is not even participating in the upcoming debate. We had no knowledge about whether Donald Trump has ever worked with Rasmussen previously. **Not only is the RNC running away from anything associated with President Trump, but they are blatantly LYING to America-First candidates and actively keeping us off the stage.** [**We need you to re-affirm your support for America-First, conservative policies and contribute once more to help us FIGHT BACK. Please contribute what you can TODAY so we can take on the RNC.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=d4bb63d4d1&e=0be619cbaa) Only with your help, can we continue to be successful and ensure we stand firm against the D.C. insiders to take our country back! Thank you,
Larry Elder
America First Candidate for President

| | | This Thursday, Trump will surrender to authorities in Fulton County, Georgia as he faces his 4th criminal indictment. And he should go through all the steps of every other criminal – including a mugshot. [**Add your name: We want to see Trump's mugshot! **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4363209b-bdc4-45e6-af55-c129678f775c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) When a regular person is arrested, they are typically handcuffed and required to take a mugshot. But Trump has so far been given special treatment and allowed to skip these steps with his other indictments. Trump's team is currently arguing with Georgia officials to prevent Trump from being photographed – but he should be treated the same as anyone else who breaks the law. Trump is facing serious criminal charges, and there is no reason he should be treated like a king. Trump wants to avoid the embarrassment of a mugshot? Well then maybe he shouldn't have committed his crimes in the first place. [**Add your name: Trump must have his mugshot taken, and it should be released to the public!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4906adcb-1024-4923-a11a-da8c73f340ea/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

But Trump has so far been given special treatment and allowed to skip these steps with his other indictments. Trump's team is currently arguing with Georgia officials to prevent Trump from being photographed – but he should be treated the same as anyone else who breaks the law. Trump is facing serious criminal charges, and there is no reason he should be treated like a king. Trump wants to avoid the embarrassment of a mugshot? Well then maybe he shouldn't have committed his crimes in the first place. | | | | | | | Thank you, Left Action [P.
