Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

subject: How Fox gave Trump cover in Georgia
body:
Fox and others helped spread unsubstantiated rumors that convinced millions of Trump’s followers the claims of a stolen election were true.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1435%2E120351%2Er84Kdd)
Peter, last week Donald Trump faced his **fourth** criminal indictment in a span of just five months.
This time, prosecutors in Georgia are seeking to hold him accountable for violating the state’s **Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act** , in addition to other charges related to his attempt to overturn Georgia’s 2020 presidential election results.
**One thing should be clear:** Fox News and others in the right-wing media echo chamber helped spread a **massive amount of misinformation** that was designed to give Trump and his accomplices a veil of legitimacy over their attempt to overturn the election.
**Our newsrooms have laid out the facts about the Big Lie from the very beginning, and we’ll never shy away from calling out misinformation — on this topic or any other:**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230822?refcode=em20230822&amount=5&refcode2=1435_120351_r84Kdd&akid=1435%2E120351%2Er84Kdd)
[**Will you pitch in $5 or any amount you can today to help us keep providing reliable, fact-based reporting to the communities that need it most?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230822?refcode=em20230822&amount=5&refcode2=1435_120351_r84Kdd&akid=1435%2E120351%2Er84Kdd)
**[Donate $5 now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230822?refcode=em20230822&amount=5&refcode2=1435_120351_r84Kdd&akid=1435%2E120351%2Er84Kdd)**
Donald Trump’s claims of massive, widespread voter fraud in 2020 were never anything more than fiction, **yet Fox and others helped spread unsubstantiated rumors** that convinced millions of Trump’s followers that his bogus claims were true.
**A poll worker was even harassed at her home over false accusations** that she had somehow acted improperly, highlighting the potentially dangerous consequences of spreading this type of misinformation.
Courier Newsroom is committed to doing things differently. Our mission is to bring the facts to our readers and provide the context needed to understand them, _not_ to drive ad revenue with clickbait headlines and viral gossip.
**But with none of our content locked behind a paywall, we rely on donors like you to fund our work. And with newsrooms in _nine_ battleground states (and more coming soon), there’s a lot of work to get done.**

**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.** [Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/51766?t=7&akid=9997%2E878179%2EdXsgyx) | [DONATE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/51766?t=8&akid=9997%2E878179%2EdXsgyx)
---
**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.

**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, friend,_we can take him down._**

**So please, I’m personally asking:** [Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/51766?t=9&akid=9997%2E878179%2EdXsgyx)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and VPP will go through immediately:

Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.

With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Friend, A Black woman, 8 months pregnant, was falsely arrested due to racist facial recognition technology. **This technology discriminates against Black and brown people, and it’s making us less safe. We must urgently stop its use to protect our communities.** So I’m supporting the _Facial Recognition and Biometric Technology Moratorium Act_ , which would:

* Place a prohibition on the use of facial recognition technology by federal entities
* Place a prohibition on the use of other biometric technologies such as voice recognition by federal entities
* Condition federal grant funding to state and local entities, including law enforcement, on those entities enacting their own moratoria on the use of facial recognition and biometric technology
* Prohibit the use of federal dollars for biometric surveillance systems

I’m co-leading the _Facial Recognition and Biometric Technology Moratorium Act_ that would:

* Place a prohibition on the use of other biometric technologies such as voice recognition by federal entities;

Too many politicians and organizations see their supporters as ATM machines. Using scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating. You are a HUGE part of our team, Peter. Here’s what we believe: \- Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action. \- Instead of guilt-tripping you for not donating enough, we want our emails to give you valuable insight. We try to send out informative, educational content. \- Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help us in other ways. But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have fundraising goals and deadlines. Everything we raise each quarter is detailed in our public FEC report, and we want to post the biggest possible fundraising numbers. Last cycle, Lori’s opponent out-fundraised her - and we are determined to NEVER let that happen again. | | If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. We still want you here, and we still appreciate you reading our emails. The truth is we need all of our supporters to open each and every email we send out. It’s the only way we are going to make big changes in Oregon. We’re glad you’re here, Peter! Team Lori | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. ---
Friend,

Donald J. Trump – who once wielded the power of the American presidency and is now seeking to retake the office – has now been criminally indicted _four times over_ for a myriad of alleged crimes.
Having served as both a former U.S. Attorney and a state Attorney General for over 20 years, I believe that the evidence to consider criminal charges against the former President for his conduct after the 2020 election is strong. Now the idea of criminal accountability for Trump is no longer in the realm of the possible - the charges are here. To be clear: Like any defendant in our system of justice, Trump must be presumed innocent until proven guilty. He deserves to have his day in court, and we must continue to let the legal process play out.
**But there is a real risk that the federal trial against the former President will take place behind closed doors – out of direct sight of the public. That would be a grave mistake.**

The federal trial over Trump’s attempts to overturn the 2020 election stands to be perhaps the most important trial in the history of American democracy. Yet, absent action from Chief Justice Roberts, no cameras will be allowed in the courtroom.
**As Americans, we deserve to see this historic trial with our own eyes – not merely filtered through the lens of political pundits and the media, or Trump’s own social media distortion machine. That’s why I’m hoping you’ll join me in demanding transparency. [If you believe Trump’s trials should be televised, will you please click here to add your voice right away?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68498967/423220002/-1389173919?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk1344-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOThjY2Y0NDQtMjI0MS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vnWshgRNjCEpirIft-HpTpteHCPva5uMvr0rrZZRXjk=&emci=c1355e0a-3f40-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=98ccf444-2241-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9329426)**
| | | [ADD YOUR VOICE:
SHOULD TRUMP’S TRIALS BE TELEVISED?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68498968/423220003/-1389173919?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk1344-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOThjY2Y0NDQtMjI0MS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vnWshgRNjCEpirIft-HpTpteHCPva5uMvr0rrZZRXjk=&emci=c1355e0a-3f40-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=98ccf444-2241-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9329426)
---
In this country, no one – not even a former President – is above the law. With the stakes for our democracy so high, and as Trump continues to ask voters for their support in his 2024 campaign for President, nothing less than full transparency with regards to his criminal trial can be accepted. The American people can be trusted with the facts. We are capable of evaluating them for ourselves. We do not need to be spoon-fed filtered sound bites by interpreters. We must demand to know.
Thank you for raising your voice at this critical time for our nation. Sincerely,
Dick

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
It's time to put the pressure on those with the power and influence to put a stop to this clear corporate grab for power.
#
Peter,
A few days ago we reached out to share the insidious plan to put Trump back in office. **Just to refresh your memory** : No Labels is a corporate-backed group with the goal to add a moderate third party candidate to ballots across the country. At first glance, this seems like a sensible option to our election process — but we're not fooled.
Now, this week, Former Maryland Gov. Larry Hogan made a point to say that No Labels' plan will ultimately launch a third-party "alternative" to undermine President Biden if former President Trump and President Biden win the nominations for their parties.
**It's time to put the pressure on those with the power and influence to put a stop to this clear corporate grab for power.[If you stand with us, please contribute to our movement and boost our fight against No Labels' plan to undermine President Biden and our democracy. ](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44696?refcode=em20230822-2839&t=1&akid=2839%2E420207%2Eu5l3Wh)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44696?refcode=em20230822-2839&t=20&akid=2839%2E420207%2Eu5l3Wh)**
No Labels is hoping to use underhanded tactics to fool people into thinking they are harmless. **But we know that this is an elaborate ploy to siphon votes from President Biden and float the election towards Trump and his far-right extremist campaign.**
Now more than ever, we need to build public pressure against No Labels and continue educating our voter base about their true intentions: _To sway the election in favor of Trump and undermine our democracy._
**This is a shame and a clear path to election interference right in front of our eyes. And we won't let this happen.[Chip in today to support our collective movement to put an end to No Labels and continue fighting for our democracy and an election system that we can all trust. ](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44696?refcode=em20230822-2839&t=21&akid=2839%2E420207%2Eu5l3Wh)**
In solidarity,
Jayapal HQ

I’m running for the Virginia Senate to ensure that Governor Youngkin and the extreme Republicans in Richmond can never do to Virginia what they’ve done to Texas. But with Republicans controlling the Governor’s Mansion and House of Delegates, and Democrats clinging to a slim majority in the Senate, the stakes could not be higher in this election.
The bottom line is this: Abortion access is on the ballot in the Commonwealth this November.

Thank you for being such a valued member of our team, there.

name: Mark Mullet
subject: getting sh*t done
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elect Mark Mullet
body:
| | Here’s the thing:

I know the job of Governor of Washington isn’t just about making big speeches at press conferences, ribbon cuttings, or bill signings.

Sometimes (most of the time), governing is about keeping the lights on and the plumbing running.

**I’m proud to have been recognized as Legislator of the Year by the Washington Association of Sewer and Water Districts because I’m committed to getting sh*t done.**

This award was in large part for my work making sure our local sewer districts have the tools they need to improve infrastructure and services to Washington families by supporting our Public Works Assistance Account.

It’s not glamorous, and it doesn’t make for great campaign buttons, but when the State is a better financial partner for local water and sewer districts, it helps make Washington State more affordable by keeping your utility bills lower – which, plunger jokes aside, helps deliver essential public services at a price families can afford.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=3506%2E5257348%2EOKyg0x ]Adam Schiff for Senate

It’s Adam Schiff here. I wanted to make sure you heard that my friend
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is running for the U.S. Senate. Her message is
below:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_dmp.23a0aa&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=3506%2E5257348%2EOKyg0x ]Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Derek,

My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former
Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott
and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch
him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect
our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m
prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024,
and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64
million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The
only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots
Democrats like you.

I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of
launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach
it. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_dmp.23a0aa&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=3506%2E5257348%2EOKyg0x ]Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Adam
Schiff right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_dmp.23a0aa&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=3506%2E5257348%2EOKyg0x ]DONATE

When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to
find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom
worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn
English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends
meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a
brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college,
become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write
the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of
Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time
in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my
family a shot at a better life.

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars,
yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class.
He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to
end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.

That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick
will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means
that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you,
Derek, we can take him down.

So please, I’m personally asking: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_dmp.23a0aa&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20230822_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=3506%2E5257348%2EOKyg0x ]Will you become one of my very first
grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Adam Schiff
today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and
defending our Senate majority.

It's no secret: There's a national teacher shortage, and Delaware is being impacted too. **Our state teacher's union predicts there will be 400 fewer teachers in public school classrooms as kids return to school this month.** And it’s perfectly clear why we have such a shortage:
* Burnout from the pandemic
* Long hours
* Low pay
* Inflexible schedules

I'm treating this as the crisis it is. It’s why I’ve supported pay raises for educators (including in this year’s budget). And it’s why I cosponsored a bill – now a law – in the last legislative session that allows teachers to use up to 5 days of their sick leave as personal days and gives them more flexibility on taking time off to attend a funeral. Seems like a small and easy thing to do to give teachers a little more dignity, right? Opponents of the bill didn't think so. They took a hard stance that teachers need to be in the classroom, no excuses. **But that's exactly the kind of inflexible attitude that is driving talented educators out of the profession.** Educators are people and their life events don’t always happen when school is out. I was lucky to have some incredible teachers in my life. People like Joe Masiello, who taught me almost every SAT word in his sixth grade English class; Brian Winnington, who seemed to wear every hat from classroom educator and football coach to mock trial sponsor and student government advisor; dedicated and passionate professionals building communities by preparing the next generation. That’s the kind of work we should celebrate and center in our politics. That's why I'll always have teachers' backs – whether it's in the Delaware General Assembly or the halls of Congress. Because the only way we ensure every kid has a great teacher is to make sure great teachers are able to stick around. Have a great back to school season, Sarah P.S. name: Ro Khanna
subject: ProPublica exposes STILL MORE Supreme Court corruption
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

A new ProPublica report [https://www.propublica.org/article/clarence-thomas-other-billionaires-sokol-huizenga-novelly-supreme-court] this week shows that Clarence Thomas accepted and failed to report far more luxury travel and vacations from more billionaires than was previously known.

Our Founders gave Supreme Court justices lifetime appointments with the intention of ensuring impartiality and insulating the justices from external political and social pressures. Since then, however, the Court has become deeply politicized.

Clarence Thomas is not the only one. Far from being insulated from political and social pressures, several justices have embraced them -- accepting millions of dollars of luxury travel and "gifts" from billionaires who fund lawsuits or stand to benefit from cases before the Supreme Court.

This is dangerously incompatible with our nation’s highest ideals. All political leaders need to know the public wants reform.

Sign if you agree: We must restore the American people’s trust and confidence in the Supreme Court with reforms – such as term limits and strict ethics rules for Supreme Court justices. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/tell-congress-enact-meaningful-reform-of-the-supreme-court?source=direct_link&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpccc-scotus-ethics-petition-swap]

Sign the Petition [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/tell-congress-enact-meaningful-reform-of-the-supreme-court?source=direct_link&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpccc-scotus-ethics-petition-swap]

ProPublica:

"A cadre of industry titans and ultra-wealthy executives have treated [Thomas] to far-flung vacations aboard their yachts, ushered him into the premium suites at sporting events and sent their private jets to fetch him -- including, on more than one occasion, an entire 737.

"Like clockwork, Thomas’ leisure activities have been underwritten by benefactors who share the ideology that drives his jurisprudence. Their gifts include:

"At least 38 destination vacations, including a previously unreported voyage on a yacht around the Bahamas; 26 private jet flights, plus an additional eight by helicopter; a dozen VIP passes to professional and college sporting events, typically perched in the skybox; two stays at luxury resorts in Florida and Jamaica; and one standing invitation to an uber-exclusive golf club overlooking the Atlantic coast."

Sign if you agree: Congress must enact meaningful ethics reform for the Supreme Court. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/tell-congress-enact-meaningful-reform-of-the-supreme-court?source=direct_link&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpccc-scotus-ethics-petition-swap]

From overturning Roe v. Wade to rejecting student loan cancellation, unelected Justices are implementing a partisan agenda that most Americans strongly oppose. It is anti-democratic, and it needs to end.

The American people's confidence in our democracy has been shaken by this Court’s ethical lapses and political rulings that go against the will of the people. Recent polling by the Progressive Change Institute and Data For Progress show that, by 2 to 1, Americans see this Court as corrupt and facing a legitimacy crisis. The Court needs reform.

To re-establish the Supreme Court as an impartial, nonpartisan branch of the federal government, I introduced the Supreme Court Term Limits and Regular Appointments Act, which would create an 18-year term limit for justices. Today, justices have an incentive to strategize and plan their retirements around whichever party holds the White House – locking in justices like Clarence Thomas for decades.

In addition, Supreme Court Justices are not held to the same ethics rules as other federal judges. Perversely, when a judge is elevated to the highest court in the land, their ethical standards go down.

Sign if you agree: Congress must act to restore the American people’s trust by passing reforms such as term limits and strict ethics rules for Supreme Court Justices. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/tell-congress-enact-meaningful-reform-of-the-supreme-court?source=direct_link&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpccc-scotus-ethics-petition-swap]

Your signature will help push Congress into action, and make this a campaign issue. It’s time to get the Supreme Court back on track.

In solidarity,
Ro

clean_body: [] Friend, A new ProPublica report [] this week shows that Clarence Thomas accepted and failed to report far more luxury travel and vacations from more billionaires than was previously known. Our Founders gave Supreme Court justices lifetime appointments with the intention of ensuring impartiality and insulating the justices from external political and social pressures. Since then, however, the Court has become deeply politicized. Clarence Thomas is not the only one. Far from being insulated from political and social pressures, several justices have embraced them -- accepting millions of dollars of luxury travel and "gifts" from billionaires who fund lawsuits or stand to benefit from cases before the Supreme Court. This is dangerously incompatible with our nation’s highest ideals. All political leaders need to know the public wants reform. Sign if you agree: We must restore the American people’s trust and confidence in the Supreme Court with reforms – such as term limits and strict ethics rules for Supreme Court justices. [] Sign the Petition [] ProPublica: "A cadre of industry titans and ultra-wealthy executives have treated [Thomas] to far-flung vacations aboard their yachts, ushered him into the premium suites at sporting events and sent their private jets to fetch him -- including, on more than one occasion, an entire 737. "Like clockwork, Thomas’ leisure activities have been underwritten by benefactors who share the ideology that drives his jurisprudence. Their gifts include: "At least 38 destination vacations, including a previously unreported voyage on a yacht around the Bahamas; 26 private jet flights, plus an additional eight by helicopter; a dozen VIP passes to professional and college sporting events, typically perched in the skybox; two stays at luxury resorts in Florida and Jamaica; and one standing invitation to an uber-exclusive golf club overlooking the Atlantic coast." Sign if you agree: Congress must enact meaningful ethics reform for the Supreme Court. [] From overturning Roe v. Wade to rejecting student loan cancellation, unelected Justices are implementing a partisan agenda that most Americans strongly oppose. It is anti-democratic, and it needs to end. The American people's confidence in our democracy has been shaken by this Court’s ethical lapses and political rulings that go against the will of the people. Recent polling by the Progressive Change Institute and Data For Progress show that, by 2 to 1, Americans see this Court as corrupt and facing a legitimacy crisis. The Court needs reform. To re-establish the Supreme Court as an impartial, nonpartisan branch of the federal government, I introduced the Supreme Court Term Limits and Regular Appointments Act, which would create an 18-year term limit for justices. Today, justices have an incentive to strategize and plan their retirements around whichever party holds the White House – locking in justices like Clarence Thomas for decades. In addition, Supreme Court Justices are not held to the same ethics rules as other federal judges. Perversely, when a judge is elevated to the highest court in the land, their ethical standards go down. Sign if you agree: Congress must act to restore the American people’s trust by passing reforms such as term limits and strict ethics rules for Supreme Court Justices. [] Your signature will help push Congress into action, and make this a campaign issue. It’s time to get the Supreme Court back on track. Peter,

It’s been a busy summer, and we just wanted to catch you up with everything we have been up to here at Team Liz! We are humbled by the supportive and growing team we have seen alongside us over the past few months and are so excited to keep working together as we move ahead.

This summer, Team Liz has been out knocking on doors for candidates all across the ballot this November. One of our highlights was knocking on doors in Yorktown for the Yorktown Democratic slate, where we connected with so many voters and had the opportunity to hear more about their issues and concerns for this upcoming election! Our team also had a blast at the South Salem Carnival and at the Westchester and Putnam Co. Labor picnic, meeting with voters, supporting our local unions, and even trying some of the great food our district has to offer!

Earlier this month, Team Liz was joined by Congressman Eric Swalwell for a meet and greet in Mt. Kisco! It was great to see New Yorkers together, fired up and ready to take back the House – and we are so thankful to Congressman Swalwell for joining us. name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Save our oceans this summer from plastic
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1941700?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT PLASTIC PETITION: Our oceans and our planet are facing a PLASTIC CRISIS.[Act now to demand the Biden Administration execute immediate federal solutions>> ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1941701?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Friend, imagine planning a beach day with your friends. You all are excited to build massive sandcastles together, dip into the cool ocean water, and bask in the summer sun. _It’s going to be a good day!_ As you approach the ocean shore, you notice debris amongst the golden sand, but it does not seem to be seaweed, shells, or driftwood. You discover that **the beach is covered with PLASTIC WASTE.** You stumble through piles of trash to make it to the ocean. Only to discover that the water is **POLLUTED** with plastic bottles, bags, and scraps. **This is serious, Friend... really serious!** Our oceans are at risk of becoming a **PLASTIC JUNKYARD.** Every minute, a garbage truck’s worth of plastic is washed into the ocean. Imagine swimming amongst TRUCKLOADS of plastic! Innocent baby sea turtles are mistaking plastic as food—plastic is _CHOKING_ _them_ and _PIERCING_ _their tiny throats_. Dolphins confuse plastic scraps for squid which disrupts their digestive systems. _It only takes**ONE** single piece of plastic to **KILL** a sea turtle, a dolphin, a seal_... [**There is only one planet Earth, Friend, and we’re at risk of destroying it if we do not DEMAND federal solutions FAST. We need 2,635 from your state to SAVE our oceans, marine animals, and the planet >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1941702?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1941703?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Big Plastic, the petrochemical companies that make these throw-away products, are not only exploiting our oceans for profit and greed, but also our very own communities and _**our bodies**_. Industrial-sized plastic factories are **spewing harmful emissions** into the environment and **forcing toxic cancer-causing pollutants** into nearby communities— _most often in low-income communities and communities of color. _
Even if you don’t live next door to Big Plastic, you can’t escape its reach. Plastic that covers our shores, ocean floors, and lands is not biodegradable, so it _**NEVER DISAPPEARS**_. Every single piece of plastic that was ever made **STILL EXISTS** in some form. There’s even microplastic in our water, food, and air.
[**As we enjoy being outside and in the ocean this summer, let’s think about the potential of our planet being destroyed by plastic pollution. YOU can help change this future. Sign the petition NOW to END plastic pollution before it is too late!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1941704?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

**Together, we can stop plastic pollution and save the planet.

clean_body: | | | | | == ---|---|--- | | URGENT PLASTIC PETITION: Our oceans and our planet are facing a PLASTIC CRISIS.== Friend, imagine planning a beach day with your friends. You all are excited to build massive sandcastles together, dip into the cool ocean water, and bask in the summer sun. It’s going to be a good day! As you approach the ocean shore, you notice debris amongst the golden sand, but it does not seem to be seaweed, shells, or driftwood. You discover that the beach is covered with PLASTIC WASTE. You stumble through piles of trash to make it to the ocean. Only to discover that the water is POLLUTED with plastic bottles, bags, and scraps. This is serious, Friend... really serious! Our oceans are at risk of becoming a PLASTIC JUNKYARD. Every minute, a garbage truck’s worth of plastic is washed into the ocean. Imagine swimming amongst TRUCKLOADS of plastic! Innocent baby sea turtles are mistaking plastic as food—plastic is CHOKING them and PIERCING their tiny throats. Dolphins confuse plastic scraps for squid which disrupts their digestive systems. It only takesONE single piece of plastic to KILL a sea turtle, a dolphin, a seal... == | == Big Plastic, the petrochemical companies that make these throw-away products, are not only exploiting our oceans for profit and greed, but also our very own communities and our bodies. Industrial-sized plastic factories are spewing harmful emissions into the environment and forcing toxic cancer-causing pollutants into nearby communities— most often in low-income communities and communities of color. Even if you don’t live next door to Big Plastic, you can’t escape its reach. Plastic that covers our shores, ocean floors, and lands is not biodegradable, so it NEVER DISAPPEARS. Every single piece of plastic that was ever made STILL EXISTS in some form. There’s even microplastic in our water, food, and air. == == Together, we can stop plastic pollution and save the planet. Friends of the Earth == == == | == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == Formatting canceled

body:
Bob’s got a tough race ahead, and he needs us all on his team.
Hey Peter, it's John Fetterman.
I'm not sure if you saw, but it was recently reported that the guy Mitch McConnell and national Republicans are "aggressively recruiting" to run against my friend Bob Casey actually lives in CONNECTICUT. 🤨
I recently told Bob to call me if he needs advice running against an out-of-state candidate, because this isn't the first time Republicans have gotten behind an ultra-wealthy dude who doesn't even live here to try to buy Pennsylvania's Senate seat. _Remember Dr. Oz???_
It's pretty straightforward: I think if you want to represent Pennsylvania in the U.S. Senate, you shouldn't be living in New Jersey OR on the wealthy "Gold Coast" of Connecticut.
[**If you agree, will you add a grassroots contribution to Bob Casey's campaign today? Bob is PA through and through, but with GOP million$ sure to be coming in, we need all the support we can get.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230822-2?amount=5&refcode=em20230822-2&refcode2=480_552475_1lBnOo&akid=480%2E552475%2E1lBnOo)

body:
AOC is taking on the old Democratic Party establishment
#
When Alexandria won in 2018, her message inspired a lot of people. She was fearless in critiquing politics-as-usual. She proposed big, new ideas — like the Green New Deal — to tackle our most difficult challenges.
While Alexandria’s message resonated across the country, some Democratic Party leaders responded very differently. They called her ideas extreme and more than a few of them attacked her personally.
[We need to make it clear: there’s nothing wrong with new ideas and holding your own Party accountable. Will you make a $5 contribution today to show you stand with Alexandria and support pushing the Democratic Party forward?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230822-2.L-oL-Y&refcode=em20230822-4859-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4859%2E2526796%2E1anM9J)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230822-2.L-oL-Y&refcode=em20230822-4859-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4859%2E2526796%2E1anM9J)**
We need to show widespread support for Alexandria so she can continue doing what she was elected to do: **demand better.**
Alexandria campaigned on expanding Medicare in order to make prescriptions more affordable. Now, Medicare has the power to negotiate prescription drugs — and insulin is capped at $35/ month. Alexandria’s Green New Deal was called pie-in-the-sky, but last year, Congress passed its largest ever investment to fight climate change — $369 billion. Now, Alexandria is fighting to ban trading stock for Members of Congress, after it was revealed that 277 lawmakers did not disclose individual stock investments in 2020 — and 75 of them directly profited from stocks in the companies that developed COVID-19 vaccines.1
[Every dollar, no matter the amount, shows widespread support for our progressive priorities from NY-14 and beyond.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230822-2.L-oL-Y&refcode=em20230822-4859-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4859%2E2526796%2E1anM9J)

Our sincerest thanks,
Team AOC

Peter,

**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — _and win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.[_Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68503970/423236282/-225452087?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230822-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlODBhOGZkLTM2NDEtZWUxMS1hM2YxLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=u379NkdCMeE9pa9c7ei8xT_dpvxoRCbS52Eyv6fHQSo=)**

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.

**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter,_we can take him down._**

**So please, I’m personally asking:[_Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Fight for Progress today? clean_body: | | | | Does Joe know he’s supposed to be at work? Hey, My Friend. How long could you skip work and still keep your job? One day? Two? How about skipping work 40% of the time? Would that fly with your boss? I doubt it but that’s exactly how much time Joe Biden has taken off. He’s supposed to be working for us! | \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Kat Cammack Subject: Where’s No Show Joe? To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Begin forwarded message: Fellow American, Do you know where Joe Biden is? While gas prices surge and Hawaii burns, No-Show Joe went on ANOTHER vacation, breaking his own record yet again for Most Vacation Days by a US President. You read that right: Joe Biden has spent 369 days of his presidency on vacation. That’s 40% of his term so far! Don’t get me wrong, I’d be happy to see Joe Biden on vacation... once we retire him! But until then, Joe Biden has a job to do. Your tax dollars pay politicians’ salaries, you deserve leaders who work just as hard as you do! | | Could you imagine if you spent 40% of your job on vacation? You and I would be FIRED! It’s time for us to hold No-Show Joe to those same standards. | | | Rep. Kat Cammack Congresswoman FL-3 | | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" ---|---|--- | Kat Cammack, the youngest Republican woman in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life. Congresswoman Cammack, now in her second term, sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government. Friend, **The time for chirping from the sidelines is over.** Wednesday night is the night we've been preparing for. It's our opportunity to reach millions of voters who can join our movement and build a better future for this country. Talk is ineffective, and that's why my message has been simple: **2024 is the time to put up or shut up**. I will make this clear on the debate stage this Wednesday. As a leader, your job is to put the interests of the people you serve above your own political gain. I've done that in Florida, and I've watched the American people cry out for real leadership nationwide. I am looking forward to rising to the occasion to show the nation that leadership. I debate and defend what I KNOW is right--even when it goes against the grain of the approved elite media narrative. The American people deserve a President with a track record of taking action and standing for what's right. The lack of action from our leaders across this country has gone on for far too long. Joe Biden has done more to damage to our nation than anyone, and Kamala Harris has done nothing at all. I am DONE listening to excuses, and I know you are too. If Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it's time we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the playbook for defeating the woke mob:
* Giving parents back their voice in the classroom by BANNING CRT and pornographic content for young kids

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. body:
I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.

---
| Peter,

I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68504783/423239210/-1393646812?refcode=BLU-SAN-20230822-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTY5ZTkxYS0zYTQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VkzR-mftTbHRdi8nkZyoj4iQN4YiVL0-TR_Nttg6pxU=)
_My husband and three children._
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.

We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.

My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**

_**And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it.**_

Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.

With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck.

[_**So please, will you join the fight for a better future by splitting a donation of $10 between Linda Sánchez and my campaign? Hi friend!
Yesterday, Michael held a town hall with Representative Yadira Caraveo in Northglenn, just north of Denver. It was a great opportunity to hear the thoughts, comments, and concerns of folks in Colorado.
Even if you couldn't make it, Michael still wants to hear from you. You can fill out our Town Hall Survey now to let us know about the issues that matter most to you >> [https://secure.michaelbennet.com/a/caraveo-town-hall-survey]

| | | This August, the world saw the consequences of climate change right here in Alaska, friend. The Mendenhall Glacier outside of Juneau is melting, and a recent outburst sent torrents of water rushing downstream through our state capital. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68505389/423241233/1872987908?refcode=E3837-20230822-MendenhallGlacier-Image-ClimateChange&amount=25&utm_campaign=em_230822_mendenhallglacier&utm_source=em&utm_medium=em&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDE1ZGE2OC0zYzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DbR8LjZvZLlWOBz0o7sFHMxcHwIJu1zJBvNFfXhBtfk=&emci=850320d3-3941-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=7015da68-3c41-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399) As our climate warms, glaciers are receding, and the natural dams they’ve formed for millennia are failing — causing catastrophic flooding downstream. As we’ve said before, Alaska is ground zero for climate change. We are already feeling its drastic effects. Our plan for dealing with our new reality is twofold: **First, we must work to stem the future harms of climate change.** This means listening to science, embracing sustainable technologies, and finding ways to protect our natural resources. **Second, we must ensure that we’re prepared for the inevitable impacts that cannot be stopped.** We need to invest in Alaska’s infrastructure so that we will be prepared as the landscape continues to shift around us. Climate change is already here, folks. Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund is focused on preventing the worst impacts of our warming climate while ensuring Alaska is prepared for the impacts we can’t head off. clean_body: We have a two-part plan for dealing with our new reality. | | | | | | This August, the world saw the consequences of climate change right here in Alaska, friend. The Mendenhall Glacier outside of Juneau is melting, and a recent outburst sent torrents of water rushing downstream through our state capital. As our climate warms, glaciers are receding, and the natural dams they’ve formed for millennia are failing — causing catastrophic flooding downstream. As we’ve said before, Alaska is ground zero for climate change. We are already feeling its drastic effects. Our plan for dealing with our new reality is twofold: First, we must work to stem the future harms of climate change. This means listening to science, embracing sustainable technologies, and finding ways to protect our natural resources. Second, we must ensure that we’re prepared for the inevitable impacts that cannot be stopped. We need to invest in Alaska’s infrastructure so that we will be prepared as the landscape continues to shift around us. Climate change is already here, folks. Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund is focused on preventing the worst impacts of our warming climate while ensuring Alaska is prepared for the impacts we can’t head off. | | | | Thank you, Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund | | Help us continue to build Alaska's future by to support our work. | | | Copyright © 2022 Build Alaska's Future Action Fund, All rights reserved. Joe Biden's wide-open border policies have FAILED America and created a crisis at the border. The Biden Administration wants to PUNISH Texas for taking action, while they've IGNORED our country's most pressing issue.

Texas will NOT back down from the fight to secure the border. Our deployment of floating marine barriers in the Rio Grande River is just another step to respond to this crisis and secure our border.

Hi Peter, Tomorrow night, the Republican presidential candidates will descend on Milwaukee for their first nationally-televised debate. Wisconsin is the premier battleground state in this critical election, and the GOP is laser-focused on putting every possible resource into flipping our state — and my Senate seat — red. Let me explain: Wisconsin’s 10 electoral votes were the tipping point in the last two presidential elections. Our state put Joe Biden over the top in 2020 and tipped the presidency to Donald Trump in 2016. **Both elections were decided by less than 1% — that’s about 20,000 votes.** Last year’s Senate race in Wisconsin was also decided by a razor-thin margin. Republicans won by 1% after spending a record $77 million to defend GOP Sen. Ron Johnson. If we can win those 20,000 votes, the White House and the Senate majority are virtually guaranteed to stay in Democratic hands. But if we lose those critical votes next November, Republicans will have their best shot at flipping both. Those are the stakes in Wisconsin. Election experts are already calling us “the tipping point state,” “the most pivotal of all the battlegrounds,” “a potential decider,” “the indispensable state,” and “the most fiercely contested partisan battleground in the nation.” With Wisconsin’s 10 electoral votes in play again and the Senate majority up for grabs, national Republicans are going all-in to win in our state — starting with the first GOP debate tomorrow and the Republican National Convention next summer. The GOP will throw everything they have into defeating me and flipping Wisconsin red, and I’m fighting back as hard as I possibly can. But I cannot do it alone. **[Will you make a donation ahead of tomorrow’s first GOP debate in Milwaukee to help us keep Wisconsin blue in 2024? | Peter,

**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 within the first 24 hours of launching my campaign to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.** [Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Ritchie Torres right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority? »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68506525/423245667/1314671096?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20230822_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjU5YzFkMC00MzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VWhlVUSprpB6fapXBYbimWG-K-WidfOGgt_BJJi93wk=) | [DONATE »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68506526/423245669/1314671096?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20230822_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjU5YzFkMC00MzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VWhlVUSprpB6fapXBYbimWG-K-WidfOGgt_BJJi93wk=)

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.

**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter,_we can take him down._**

**So please, I’m personally asking:** [Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Ritchie Torres today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority. »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68506527/423245671/1314671096?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20230822_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjU5YzFkMC00MzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VWhlVUSprpB6fapXBYbimWG-K-WidfOGgt_BJJi93wk=)

body:
Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it. |
#
Friend, my name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68506825/423246671/-1890717080?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230822_PM1_V1_S4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWNkZGI3Yi00NzQxLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XAUIVSszD2pAaX5qH0sujVLe9x748TWGZoq4f3CxLZ8=) _My husband and three children._ I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life. We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet. My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.** **_And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it._** Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet. My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.
